    ,country_subdivision.subdivision_name
    ,ship_to.epr_flag
    ,oe_hdr.tariff_enabled_flag
    ,'N' convert_to_order
    /*MAIN FROM CLAUSE*/  FROM
    oe_hdr
    INNER JOIN company ON (company.company_id = oe_hdr.company_id)
    LEFT JOIN users ON (users.id = oe_hdr.taker)
    INNER JOIN address AS address_a ON (address_a.id = oe_hdr.location_id)
    INNER JOIN address AS address_b ON (address_b.id = oe_hdr.customer_id)
    LEFT JOIN address AS address_c ON (address_c.id = oe_hdr.address_id)
    INNER JOIN address AS address_d ON (address_d.id = oe_hdr.source_location_id)
    LEFT JOIN ship_to ON (ship_to.ship_to_id = oe_hdr.address_id)
    AND (ship_to.customer_id = oe_hdr.customer_id)
    AND (ship_to.company_id = oe_hdr.company_id)
    LEFT JOIN freight_code ON (freight_code.freight_code_uid = oe_hdr.freight_code_uid)
    LEFT JOIN shipping_route ON (shipping_route.shipping_route_uid = oe_hdr.shipping_route_uid)
    LEFT JOIN p21_view_oe_hdr_rfq_control_no ON p21_view_oe_hdr_rfq_control_no.oe_hdr_uid = oe_hdr.oe_hdr_uid
    INNER JOIN invoice_batch ON (invoice_batch.invoice_batch_uid = oe_hdr.invoice_batch_uid)
    INNER JOIN customer ON customer.customer_id = oe_hdr.customer_id
    AND customer.company_id = oe_hdr.company_id
    LEFT JOIN currency_line ON (currency_line.currency_line_uid = oe_hdr.currency_line_uid)
    LEFT JOIN quote_hdr ON quote_hdr.oe_hdr_uid = oe_hdr.oe_hdr_uid
    LEFT JOIN crm_contact_information ON crm_contact_information.entity_link_id_dec = oe_hdr.customer_id
    AND crm_contact_information.company_id = oe_hdr.company_id
    AND crm_contact_information.entity_type_cd = 1203
    LEFT JOIN pegmost_oe_hdr ON pegmost_oe_hdr.oe_hdr_uid = oe_hdr.oe_hdr_uid
    LEFT JOIN carrier_contract_hdr ON carrier_contract_hdr.carrier_contract_hdr_uid = oe_hdr.carrier_contract_hdr_uid
    LEFT JOIN oe_hdr_notepad ON oe_hdr_notepad.note_id = (SELECT TOP 1 oe_hdr_notepad.note_id
    FROM oe_hdr_notepad
    WHERE oe_hdr_notepad.order_no = oe_hdr.order_no
    AND oe_hdr_notepad.delete_flag = 'N')
    LEFT JOIN oe_hdr_notepad oe_hdr_notepad_first ON oe_hdr_notepad_first.note_id = oe_hdr_notepad.note_id
    LEFT JOIN oe_hdr_integration ON (oe_hdr.order_no = oe_hdr_integration.order_no)
    LEFT JOIN country_subdivision ON (ship_to.country_subdivision_uid is not null and country_subdivision.country_subdivision_uid = ship_to.country_subdivision_uid)  /*MAIN WHERE CLAUSE*/  /*MAIN GROUP BY CLAUSE*/  /*MAIN HAVING CLAUSE*/  /*MAIN ORDER BY CLAUSE*/

    INNER JOIN address AS address_b ON (address_b.id = oe_hdr.customer_id)
    LEFT JOIN address AS address_c ON (address_c.id = oe_hdr.address_id)
    INNER JOIN address AS address_d ON (address_d.id = oe_hdr.source_location_id)

    AND (ship_to.company_id = oe_hdr.company_id)

    INNER JOIN customer ON customer.customer_id = oe_hdr.customer_id
    AND customer.company_id = oe_hdr.company_id
    LEFT JOIN currency_line ON (currency_line.currency_line_uid = oe_hdr.currency_line_uid)
    LEFT JOIN quote_hdr ON quote_hdr.oe_hdr_uid = oe_hdr.oe_hdr_uid
    LEFT JOIN crm_contact_information ON crm_contact_information.entity_link_id_dec = oe_hdr.customer_id
    AND crm_contact_information.company_id = oe_hdr.company_id
    AND crm_contact_information.entity_type_cd = 1203
    LEFT JOIN pegmost_oe_hdr ON pegmost_oe_hdr.oe_hdr_uid = oe_hdr.oe_hdr_uid
    LEFT JOIN carrier_contract_hdr ON carrier_contract_hdr.carrier_contract_hdr_uid = oe_hdr.carrier_contract_hdr_uid
    LEFT JOIN oe_hdr_notepad ON oe_hdr_notepad.note_id = (SELECT TOP 1 oe_hdr_notepad.note_id
    FROM oe_hdr_notepad
    WHERE oe_hdr_notepad.order_no = oe_hdr.order_no
    AND oe_hdr_notepad.delete_flag = 'N')
    LEFT JOIN oe_hdr_notepad oe_hdr_notepad_first ON oe_hdr_notepad_first.note_id = oe_hdr_notepad.note_id
    LEFT JOIN oe_hdr_integration ON (oe_hdr.order_no = oe_hdr_integration.order_no)
    LEFT JOIN country_subdivision ON (ship_to.country_subdivision_uid is not null and country_subdivision.country_subdivision_uid = ship_to.country_subdivision_uid)  /*MAIN WHERE CLAUSE*/  /*MAIN GROUP BY CLAUSE*/  /*MAIN HAVING CLAUSE*/  /*MAIN ORDER BY CLAUSE*/

    AND crm_contact_information.entity_type_cd = 1203

    WHERE oe_hdr_notepad.order_no = oe_hdr.order_no
    AND oe_hdr_notepad.delete_flag = 'N')
    LEFT JOIN oe_hdr_notepad oe_hdr_notepad_first ON oe_hdr_notepad_first.note_id = oe_hdr_notepad.note_id

SELECT oe_pick_ticket.pick_ticket_no,
    oe_pick_ticket.print_date print_date,
    oe_pick_ticket.invoice_no,
    CASE
    WHEN COALESCE(oe_pick_ticket.invoice_no, 0)=0
    THEN ''
    ELSE
    'Shipped'
    END picking_status,
    CASE
    WHEN COALESCE(oe_pick_ticket.invoice_no, 0)=0
    THEN 0
    ELSE
    100
    END percent_picked,
    '' bin
    ,CASE
    WHEN group_pick_ticket_hdr.transaction_type_cd = 1941 THEN group_pick_ticket_hdr.group_pick_ticket_hdr_uid
    ELSE NULL
    END
    ,CASE
    WHEN group_pick_ticket_hdr.transaction_type_cd = 1941 THEN group_pick_ticket_hdr.row_status_flag
    ELSE NULL
    END
    , CASE
    WHEN group_pick_ticket_hdr.transaction_type_cd = 1881 THEN group_pick_ticket_hdr.group_pick_ticket_hdr_uid
    ELSE NULL
    END
    , NULL
    , group_pick_ticket_hdr.location_id
    FROM oe_pick_ticket
    INNER JOIN oe_hdr ON oe_hdr.order_no = oe_pick_ticket.order_no
    INNER JOIN location ON location.location_id = oe_pick_ticket.location_id
    AND location.rf_enabled_flag = 'Y'
    AND oe_pick_ticket.delete_flag = 'N'
    LEFT JOIN group_pick_ticket_detail ON  group_pick_ticket_detail.pick_ticket_no = oe_pick_ticket.pick_ticket_no
    LEFT JOIN  group_pick_ticket_hdr ON group_pick_ticket_hdr.group_pick_ticket_hdr_uid = group_pick_ticket_detail.group_pick_ticket_hdr_uid
    AND group_pick_ticket_hdr.transaction_type_cd IN (1881, 1941)

SELECT oe_pick_ticket.pick_ticket_no
    ,oe_pick_ticket.print_date
    ,COALESCE( p21_view_clippership_return_<id>.carrier_name, address.name ) c_carrier
    ,COALESCE( p21_view_clippership_return_<id>.tracking_no, ptshipment.shipment_id, oe_pick_ticket.tracking_no ) c_tracking_no
    ,COALESCE(  p21_view_clippership_return_<id>.total_charge,  oe_pick_ticket.freight_out, 0.00 ) c_freight_out
    ,COALESCE(oe_pick_ticket.freight_in, 0.00) freight_in
    ,oe_pick_ticket.pick_and_hold
    ,COALESCE( p21_view_clippership_return_<id>.shipped_date, oe_pick_ticket.ship_date ) c_ship_date
    ,oe_pick_ticket.invoice_no
    ,oe_pick_ticket.auxiliary
    ,oe_pick_ticket.direct_shipment
    ,oe_pick_ticket.delete_flag
    ,oe_pick_ticket.order_no
    ,oe_pick_ticket.total_tax
    ,freight_code.freight_cd
    ,oe_pick_ticket.freight_code_uid
    ,oe_hdr.packing_basis
    ,oe_hdr.company_id
    ,oe_pick_ticket.oe_pick_ticket_type_cd
    ,oe_pick_ticket.outgoing_freight_cost
    ,CASE
    WHEN oe_pick_ticket_type_cd = 1921 THEN 'Parts Pick Ticket'
    WHEN oe_pick_ticket_type_cd = 1922 THEN 'Service Pick Ticket'
    WHEN oe_pick_ticket.direct_shipment = 'Y' THEN 'Direct Shipment'
    WHEN oe_pick_ticket.auxiliary = 'Y' THEN 'Auxiliary Pick Ticket'
    WHEN oe_pick_ticket.pick_and_hold = 'Y' THEN CASE
    WHEN oe_hdr.packing_basis = 'Tag and Hold' THEN 'Tag And Hold'
    ELSE 'Pick And Hold'
    END
    ELSE CASE ptshipment.transaction_type_cd
    WHEN 222 THEN 'Shipped via Order Entry'
    ELSE 'Regular Pick Ticket'
    END
    END + CASE
    WHEN COALESCE( p21_view_clippership_return_<id>.clippership_return_uid, 0 ) <> 0 THEN
    CASE system_setting.value
    WHEN 'Y' THEN
    ' (Quick Ship)'
    ELSE
    ' (Clippership)'
    END
    WHEN COALESCE( ptshipment.shipment_uid, 0 ) <> 0 THEN ' (' + carriertype.code_description + ')'
    ELSE ''
    END shipment_type_display
    ,CASE ptshipment.transaction_type_cd
    WHEN 222 THEN oe_hdr.order_no
    ELSE oe_pick_ticket.pick_ticket_no
    END transaction_no
    ,ptshipment.shipment_uid shipment_uid
    ,p21_view_clippership_return_<id>.clippership_return_uid clippership_return_uid
    ,address.carrier_type_cd
    ,COALESCE( ptshipment.ship_location_id, oe_pick_ticket.location_id )
    ,ptshipment.transaction_type_cd transaction_type_cd
    ,0 strategic_freight_out
    ,oe_pick_ticket.carrier_id
    ,company_strategic_pricing.retail_warehouse_separate_flag
    ,oe_hdr.front_counter front_counter_order
    ,location.strategic_retail_location_flag
    ,oe_hdr.customer_id
    ,CASE invoice_hdr.record_type_cd
    WHEN 2594 THEN invoice_hdr.record_type_reference_no
    ELSE ''
    END
    ,COALESCE( drv_lot_bill_packing_basis.protect_packing_basis, 'N' ) protect_packing_basis
    ,ups_shipping_route.route_description
    ,oe_pick_ticket_ups.shipping_route_stop
    ,( driver.first_name + ' ' + driver.last_name ) driver_name
    ,CASE
    WHEN oe_pick_ticket_ups.sent_to_roadnet_flag = 'N' THEN 'N'
    WHEN oe_pick_ticket_ups.sent_to_roadnet_flag = 'Y' AND oe_pick_ticket_ups.shipping_route_uid IS NULL THEN 'Y'
    WHEN oe_pick_ticket_ups.sent_to_roadnet_flag = 'Y' AND oe_pick_ticket_ups.shipping_route_uid IS NOT NULL THEN 'R'
    WHEN oe_pick_ticket_ups.sent_to_roadnet_flag = 'P' THEN 'P'
    ELSE 'N'
    END roadnet_status
    ,oe_pick_ticket.rfnav_pick_status_cd  /*MAIN FROM CLAUSE*/  FROM oe_pick_ticket  INNER JOIN oe_hdr ON oe_hdr.order_no = oe_pick_ticket.order_no  LEFT  JOIN p21_view_clippership_return_<id> ON ( p21_view_clippership_return_<id>.pick_ticket_no = oe_pick_ticket.pick_ticket_no )
    AND ( p21_view_clippership_return_<id>.delete_flag = 'N' )  LEFT  JOIN freight_code ON ( freight_code.freight_code_uid = oe_pick_ticket.freight_code_uid )  LEFT  JOIN shipment AS ptshipment ON ( ptshipment.row_status_flag = 2175 )
    AND (ptshipment.transaction_type_cd = 1000
    AND ptshipment.transaction_no = oe_pick_ticket.pick_ticket_no)  LEFT  JOIN address ON ( address.id = COALESCE( ptshipment.carrier_id, oe_pick_ticket.carrier_id ) )  LEFT  JOIN code_p21 AS carriertype ON ( carriertype.code_no = address.carrier_type_cd )  LEFT JOIN company_strategic_pricing ON company_strategic_pricing.company_id = oe_pick_ticket.company_id  LEFT JOIN location ON location.location_id = oe_hdr.location_id AND location.company_id = oe_pick_ticket.company_id  LEFT JOIN invoice_hdr ON invoice_hdr.invoice_no = cast(oe_pick_ticket.invoice_no as varchar(10))  LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT(oe_pick_ticket.pick_ticket_no), 'Y' protect_packing_basis
    FROM oe_pick_ticket
    INNER JOIN oe_pick_ticket_detail ON oe_pick_ticket.pick_ticket_no = oe_pick_ticket_detail.pick_ticket_no
    INNER JOIN oe_line ON oe_line.line_no = oe_pick_ticket_detail.oe_line_no AND oe_line.order_no = oe_pick_ticket.order_no AND oe_line.detail_type <> 3
    LEFT JOIN oe_line_lot_billing ON oe_line.oe_line_uid = oe_line_lot_billing.oe_line_uid
    WHERE ((oe_line_lot_billing.oe_line_uid IS NULL) OR (oe_line_lot_billing.packing_basis IS NULL))
    AND ((oe_line_lot_billing.price_basis IS NULL) OR (oe_line_lot_billing.price_basis <> 'N'))
    ) AS drv_lot_bill_packing_basis ON drv_lot_bill_packing_basis .pick_ticket_no = oe_pick_ticket.pick_ticket_no  LEFT JOIN oe_pick_ticket_ups ON oe_pick_ticket_ups.pick_ticket_no = oe_pick_ticket.pick_ticket_no  LEFT JOIN shipping_route AS ups_shipping_route ON ups_shipping_route.shipping_route_uid = oe_pick_ticket_ups.shipping_route_uid  LEFT JOIN contacts AS driver ON driver.id = oe_pick_ticket_ups.driver_id  INNER JOIN system_setting ON (system_setting.name = 'epicor_manifest_enabled')  /*MAIN WHERE CLAUSE*/  WHERE (NOT (oe_pick_ticket.delete_flag = 'Y' AND oe_pick_ticket.pick_and_hold = 'Y'))
    AND ( oe_hdr.order_no = :as_OrderNo )  /*MAIN GROUP BY CLAUSE*/  /*MAIN HAVING CLAUSE*/  /*MAIN ORDER BY CLAUSE*/

SELECT invoice_hdr.invoice_date,
    invoice_hdr.invoice_no,
    invoice_line.qty_shipped,
    invoice_line.qty_requested,
    invoice_line.unit_price,
    invoice_line.unit_of_measure,
    invoice_line.extended_price,
    currency_line.to_currency_id,
    invoice_hdr.order_no,
    job_price_line.line_no,
    job_price_hdr.contract_no,
    job_price_hdr.job_description,
    CASE :cost_type
    WHEN 2 THEN
    invoice_line.commission_cost * invoice_line.qty_shipped
    WHEN 3 THEN
    invoice_line.other_cost * invoice_line.qty_shipped
    ELSE
    invoice_line.cogs_amount
    END cogs_amount,
    CASE invoice_line.qty_shipped
    WHEN 0 THEN
    0
    ELSE
    (CASE :cost_type
    WHEN 2 THEN
    invoice_line.commission_cost * invoice_line.qty_shipped
    WHEN 3 THEN
    invoice_line.other_cost * invoice_line.qty_shipped
    ELSE
    invoice_line.cogs_amount
    END) / (qty_shipped / COALESCE(invoice_line.pricing_unit_size, 1))
    END c_unitcost,
    invoice_hdr.ship2_name,
    COALESCE(inv_mast.item_id, invoice_line.item_id) item_id,
    COALESCE(inv_mast.item_desc, invoice_line.item_desc) item_desc,
    COALESCE(invoice_line.pricing_unit_size, 1) pricing_unit_size,
    invoice_line.pricing_unit,
    COALESCE(invoice_line.sales_unit_size, 1) order_unit_size,
    invoice_hdr.sales_location_id,
    invoice_hdr.order_date,
    invoice_line.line_no,
    CASE customer.invoice_comp_cost_cd_tier1
    WHEN 2110 THEN /* Commission Cost */
    CASE WHEN (invoice_line.commission_cost * invoice_line.pricing_unit_size <> 0) THEN
    invoice_line.commission_cost * invoice_line.pricing_unit_size
    ELSE
    CASE customer.invoice_comp_cost_cd_tier2
    WHEN 2111 THEN
    CASE WHEN (CASE invoice_line.qty_shipped WHEN 0 THEN 0 ELSE CAST(invoice_line.cogs_amount / (invoice_line.qty_shipped / invoice_line.pricing_unit_size)  AS Decimal(19,9)) END) <> 0 THEN
    invoice_line.cogs_amount / (invoice_line.qty_shipped / invoice_line.pricing_unit_size)
    ELSE
    invoice_line.other_cost * invoice_line.pricing_unit_size
    END
    WHEN 1195 THEN
    CASE WHEN (invoice_line.other_cost * invoice_line.pricing_unit_size <> 0) THEN
    invoice_line.other_cost * invoice_line.pricing_unit_size
    ELSE
    (CASE invoice_line.qty_shipped WHEN 0 THEN 0 ELSE CAST(invoice_line.cogs_amount / (invoice_line.qty_shipped / invoice_line.pricing_unit_size)  AS Decimal(19,9)) END)
    END
    END
    END
    WHEN 2111 THEN  /* Order Cost */
    CASE WHEN (CASE invoice_line.qty_shipped WHEN 0 THEN 0 ELSE CAST(invoice_line.cogs_amount / (invoice_line.qty_shipped / invoice_line.pricing_unit_size)  AS Decimal(19,9)) END) <> 0 THEN
    invoice_line.cogs_amount / (invoice_line.qty_shipped / invoice_line.pricing_unit_size)
    ELSE
    CASE customer.invoice_comp_cost_cd_tier2
    WHEN 2110 THEN
    CASE WHEN (invoice_line.commission_cost * invoice_line.pricing_unit_size <> 0) THEN
    invoice_line.commission_cost * invoice_line.pricing_unit_size
    ELSE
    invoice_line.other_cost * invoice_line.pricing_unit_size
    END
    WHEN 1195 THEN
    CASE WHEN (invoice_line.other_cost * invoice_line.pricing_unit_size <> 0) THEN
    invoice_line.other_cost * invoice_line.pricing_unit_size
    ELSE
    invoice_line.commission_cost * invoice_line.pricing_unit_size
    END
    END
    END
    WHEN 1195 THEN  /* Other Cost */
    CASE WHEN (invoice_line.other_cost * invoice_line.pricing_unit_size <> 0) THEN
    invoice_line.other_cost * invoice_line.pricing_unit_size
    ELSE
    CASE customer.invoice_comp_cost_cd_tier2
    WHEN 2110 THEN
    CASE WHEN (invoice_line.commission_cost * invoice_line.pricing_unit_size <> 0) THEN
    invoice_line.commission_cost * invoice_line.pricing_unit_size
    ELSE
    (CASE invoice_line.qty_shipped WHEN 0 THEN 0 ELSE CAST(invoice_line.cogs_amount / (invoice_line.qty_shipped / invoice_line.pricing_unit_size)  AS Decimal(19,9)) END)
    END
    WHEN 2111 THEN
    CASE WHEN (CASE invoice_line.qty_shipped WHEN 0 THEN 0 ELSE CAST(invoice_line.cogs_amount / (invoice_line.qty_shipped / invoice_line.pricing_unit_size)  AS Decimal(19,9)) END) <> 0 THEN
    invoice_line.cogs_amount / (invoice_line.qty_shipped / invoice_line.pricing_unit_size)
    ELSE
    invoice_line.commission_cost * invoice_line.pricing_unit_size
    END
    END
    END
    END c_comparison_cost,
    CASE customer.invoice_comp_cost_cd_tier1
    WHEN 2110 THEN /* Commission Cost */
    CASE WHEN (invoice_line.commission_cost * invoice_line.qty_shipped <> 0) THEN
    invoice_line.commission_cost * invoice_line.qty_shipped
    ELSE
    CASE customer.invoice_comp_cost_cd_tier2
    WHEN 2111 THEN
    CASE WHEN (invoice_line.cogs_amount <> 0) THEN
    invoice_line.cogs_amount
    ELSE
    invoice_line.other_cost * invoice_line.qty_shipped
    END
    WHEN 1195 THEN
    CASE WHEN (invoice_line.other_cost * invoice_line.qty_shipped <> 0) THEN
    invoice_line.other_cost * invoice_line.qty_shipped
    ELSE
    invoice_line.cogs_amount
    END
    END
    END
    WHEN 2111 THEN  /* Order Cost */
    CASE WHEN (invoice_line.cogs_amount <> 0) THEN
    invoice_line.cogs_amount
    ELSE
    CASE customer.invoice_comp_cost_cd_tier2
    WHEN 2110 THEN
    CASE WHEN (invoice_line.commission_cost * invoice_line.qty_shipped <> 0) THEN
    invoice_line.commission_cost * invoice_line.qty_shipped
    ELSE
    invoice_line.other_cost * invoice_line.qty_shipped
    END
    WHEN 1195 THEN
    CASE WHEN (invoice_line.other_cost * invoice_line.qty_shipped <> 0) THEN
    invoice_line.other_cost * invoice_line.qty_shipped
    ELSE
    invoice_line.commission_cost * invoice_line.qty_shipped
    END
    END
    END
    WHEN 1195 THEN  /* Other Cost */
    CASE WHEN (invoice_line.other_cost * invoice_line.qty_shipped <> 0) THEN
    invoice_line.other_cost * invoice_line.qty_shipped
    ELSE
    CASE customer.invoice_comp_cost_cd_tier2
    WHEN 2110 THEN
    CASE WHEN (invoice_line.commission_cost * invoice_line.qty_shipped <> 0) THEN
    invoice_line.commission_cost * invoice_line.qty_shipped
    ELSE
    invoice_line.cogs_amount
    END
    WHEN 2111 THEN
    CASE WHEN (invoice_line.cogs_amount <> 0) THEN
    invoice_line.cogs_amount
    ELSE
    invoice_line.commission_cost * invoice_line.qty_shipped
    END
    END
    END
    END c_extended_comparison_cost,
    COALESCE(derv_Taxable.taxable, 'N') c_taxable,
    CASE invoice_hdr.source_type_cd
    WHEN 1129 THEN 'Y'
    WHEN 1924 THEN 'Y'
    ELSE 'N'
    END c_direct_ship
    ,CASE COALESCE( (SELECT value FROM system_setting WHERE name = 'enable_gallons_display'), 'N')
    WHEN 'N' THEN 0
    ELSE
    CASE COALESCE(item_uom_gallon.unit_size,0)
    WHEN 0 THEN
    0
    ELSE
    (invoice_line.qty_shipped  / item_uom_gallon.unit_size)
    END
    END gallons_shipped,
    CASE COALESCE( (SELECT value FROM system_setting WHERE name = 'enable_gallons_display'), 'N')
    WHEN 'N' THEN 0
    ELSE
    CASE COALESCE(item_uom_gallon.unit_size,0)
    WHEN 0 THEN
    0
    ELSE
    (invoice_line.qty_requested  / item_uom_gallon.unit_size)
    END
    END gallons_ordered
    ,oe_hdr.subject
    ,CASE invoice_hdr.record_type_cd
    WHEN 2594 THEN invoice_hdr.record_type_reference_no
    ELSE ''
    END original_rebilled_invoice_no
    ,invoice_hdr.invoice_no cc_invoice_no_display
    ,CASE
    WHEN invoice_hdr.invoice_adjustment_type = 'C' AND invoice_hdr.source_type_cd = 2638 THEN
    'Credit'
    WHEN invoice_hdr.record_type_cd = 2594 THEN
    'Rebill'
    ELSE
    ''
    END credit_or_rebill  ,invoice_line.product_group_id
    /*MAIN FROM CLAUSE*/ FROM invoice_line  INNER JOIN invoice_hdr ON (invoice_hdr.invoice_no = invoice_line.invoice_no)  LEFT OUTER JOIN inv_mast ON (inv_mast.inv_mast_uid = invoice_line.inv_mast_uid AND inv_mast.product_type <> 'L')  LEFT JOIN job_price_line ON (job_price_line.job_price_line_uid = invoice_line.job_price_line_uid)  LEFT JOIN job_price_hdr ON (job_price_hdr.job_price_hdr_uid = job_price_line.job_price_hdr_uid)  LEFT JOIN oe_hdr ON (oe_hdr.order_no = invoice_hdr.order_no)  LEFT JOIN currency_line ON (currency_line.currency_line_uid = oe_hdr.currency_line_uid)  LEFT JOIN (SELECT invoice_no, line_no, taxable
    FROM invoice_line_taxes
    WHERE taxable = 'Y'
    GROUP BY invoice_no, line_no, taxable
    ) AS derv_Taxable ON (derv_Taxable.invoice_no = invoice_line.invoice_no AND derv_Taxable.line_no = invoice_line.line_no)  INNER JOIN customer ON (invoice_hdr.customer_id = customer.customer_id AND invoice_hdr.company_no = customer.company_id)
    LEFT Join system_setting system_setting_Gallon ON ( system_setting_Gallon.configuration_id = 0 AND system_setting_Gallon.name = 'Gallon_UOM' )  LEFT JOIN item_uom item_uom_gallon ON ((item_uom_gallon.inv_mast_uid = invoice_line.inv_mast_uid) AND
    (item_uom_gallon.unit_of_measure = system_setting_Gallon.value)) /*MAIN WHERE CLAUSE*/
    WHERE invoice_hdr.company_no = :company_id
    AND invoice_hdr.sold_to_customer_id = :customer_id
    AND invoice_hdr.invoice_date >= :start_date
    AND invoice_line.tax_item = 'N'
    AND invoice_line.invoice_line_type NOT IN (4, 928, 929, 3226)
    AND invoice_hdr.invoice_class NOT IN ('Z', 'FINANCE')
    AND invoice_hdr.consolidated <> 'C'
    AND (  (:order_type <> 1877 AND COALESCE(oe_hdr.order_type, 0) <> 1877 AND invoice_hdr.invoice_adjustment_type = 'I')
    OR (:order_type = 1877 AND COALESCE(oe_hdr.order_type, 0) = 1877 AND invoice_hdr.invoice_adjustment_type = 'M')
    OR (invoice_hdr.invoice_adjustment_type = 'C' AND invoice_hdr.source_type_cd = 2638)
    )
    /* Exclude production order and kit components if excluding components */
    AND (:show_components = 'Y' OR COALESCE(invoice_line.invoice_line_type, 0) NOT IN (981, 982))
    AND COALESCE(invoice_hdr.record_type_cd, 0) <> 4015 /*MAIN GROUP BY CLAUSE*/
    /*MAIN HAVING CLAUSE*/
    /*MAIN ORDER BY CLAUSE*/

END WHEN 1195 THEN CASE WHEN (invoice_line.other_cost * invoice_line.pricing_unit_size <> 0) THEN invoice_line.other_cost * invoice_line.pricing_unit_size ELSE invoice_line.commission_cost * invoice_line.pricing_unit_size END END END WHEN 1195 THEN CASE WHEN (invoice_line.other_cost * invoice_line.pricing_unit_size <> 0) THEN invoice_line.other_cost * invoice_line.pricing_unit_size ELSE CASE customer.invoice_comp_cost_cd_tier2 WHEN 2110 THEN CASE WHEN (invoice_line.commission_cost * invoice_line.pricing_unit_size <> 0) THEN invoice_line.commission_cost * invoice_line.pricing_unit_size ELSE (CASE invoice_line.qty_shipped WHEN 0 THEN 0 ELSE CAST(invoice_line.cogs_amount / (invoice_line.qty_shipped / invoice_line.pricing_unit_size) AS Decimal(19,9)) END) END WHEN 2111 THEN CASE WHEN (CASE invoice_line.qty_shipped WHEN 0 THEN 0 ELSE CAST(invoice_line.cogs_amount / (invoice_line.qty_shipped / invoice_line.pricing_unit_size) AS Decimal(19,9)) END) <> 0 THEN invoice_line.cogs_amount / (invoice_line.qty_shipped / invoice_line.pricing_unit_size) ELSE invoice_line.commission_cost * invoice_line.pricing_unit_size END END END END

c_extended_comparison_cost.expression: CASE customer.invoice_comp_cost_cd_tier1 WHEN 2110 THEN CASE WHEN (invoice_line.commission_cost * invoice_line.qty_shipped <> 0) THEN invoice_line.commission_cost * invoice_line.qty_shipped ELSE CASE customer.invoice_comp_cost_cd_tier2 WHEN 2111 THEN CASE WHEN (invoice_line.cogs_amount <> 0) THEN invoice_line.cogs_amount ELSE invoice_line.other_cost * invoice_line.qty_shipped END WHEN 1195 THEN CASE WHEN (invoice_line.other_cost * invoice_line.qty_shipped <> 0) THEN invoice_line.other_cost * invoice_line.qty_shipped ELSE invoice_line.cogs_amount END END END WHEN 2111 THEN CASE WHEN (invoice_line.cogs_amount <> 0) THEN invoice_line.cogs_amount ELSE CASE customer.invoice_comp_cost_cd_tier2 WHEN 2110 THEN CASE WHEN (invoice_line.commission_cost * invoice_line.qty_shipped <> 0) THEN invoice_line.commission_cost * invoice_line.qty_shipped ELSE invoice_line.other_cost * invoice_line.qty_shipped END WHEN 1195 THEN CASE WHEN (invoice_line.other_cost * invoice_line.qty_shipped <> 0) THEN invoice_line.other_cost * invoice_line.qty_shipped ELSE invoice_line.commission_cost * invoice_line.qty_shipped END END END WHEN 1195 THEN CASE WHEN (invoice_line.other_cost * invoice_line.qty_shipped <> 0) THEN invoice_line.other_cost * invoice_line.qty_shipped ELSE CASE customer.invoice_comp_cost_cd_tier2 WHEN 2110 THEN CASE WHEN (invoice_line.commission_cost * invoice_line.qty_shipped <> 0) THEN invoice_line.commission_cost * invoice_line.qty_shipped ELSE invoice_line.cogs_amount END WHEN 2111 THEN CASE WHEN (invoice_line.cogs_amount <> 0) THEN invoice_line.cogs_amount ELSE invoice_line.commission_cost * invoice_line.qty_shipped END END END END

c_direct_ship.expression: CASE invoice_hdr.source_type_cd WHEN 1129 THEN 'Y' WHEN 1924 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END

c_unitcost.expression: CASE invoice_line.qty_shipped WHEN 0 THEN 0 ELSE (CASE :cost_type WHEN 2 THEN invoice_line.commission_cost * invoice_line.qty_shipped WHEN 3 THEN invoice_line.other_cost * invoice_line.qty_shipped ELSE invoice_line.cogs_amount END) / (qty_shipped / COALESCE(invoice_line.pricing_unit_size, 1)) END

cogs_amount.expression: CASE :cost_type WHEN 2 THEN invoice_line.commission_cost * invoice_line.qty_shipped WHEN 3 THEN invoice_line.other_cost * invoice_line.qty_shipped ELSE invoice_line.cogs_amount END

    /*MAIN FROM CLAUSE*/ FROM oe_line
    INNER JOIN inv_loc ON (inv_loc.inv_mast_uid = oe_line.inv_mast_uid)
    AND (inv_loc.location_id = oe_line.source_loc_id)  INNER JOIN inv_mast ON (inv_mast.inv_mast_uid = inv_loc.inv_mast_uid)  INNER JOIN product_group ON (product_group.product_group_id = oe_line.product_group_id)
    AND (product_group.company_id = inv_loc.company_id)  LEFT JOIN item_uom ON (item_uom.inv_mast_uid = oe_line.inv_mast_uid)
    AND (item_uom.unit_of_measure = oe_line.unit_of_measure)  LEFT JOIN inventory_supplier ON (inventory_supplier.inv_mast_uid = oe_line.inv_mast_uid)
    AND (inventory_supplier.supplier_id = oe_line.supplier_id)  LEFT JOIN inventory_supplier_x_loc ON (inventory_supplier.inventory_supplier_uid = inventory_supplier_x_loc.inventory_supplier_uid)
    AND (inventory_supplier_x_loc.location_id = oe_line.source_loc_id)  LEFT JOIN ( SELECT tpcx_dead_stock.inv_mast_uid, MAX(tpcx_dead_stock.tpcx_dead_stock_uid) tpcx_dead_stock_uid
    FROM tpcx_dead_stock
    GROUP BY tpcx_dead_stock.inv_mast_uid
    ) AS drv_TPCxDeadStock ON (drv_TPCxDeadStock.inv_mast_uid = inv_mast.inv_mast_uid)  INNER JOIN supplier ON (supplier.supplier_id = oe_line.supplier_id)  LEFT JOIN inv_loc_stock_status ON (inv_loc.inv_mast_uid = inv_loc_stock_status.inv_mast_uid)
    AND (inv_loc.location_id = inv_loc_stock_status.location_id)  LEFT JOIN inv_mast_assem_info ON (inv_mast_assem_info.inv_mast_uid = inv_mast.inv_mast_uid)  LEFT JOIN oe_line_hose_assembly ON (oe_line_hose_assembly.oe_line_uid = oe_line.oe_line_uid)  LEFT  JOIN oe_line_last_margin_price ON (oe_line_last_margin_price.oe_line_uid = oe_line.oe_line_uid)  LEFT  JOIN address ON (address.id = oe_line.item_bill_to_id)  INNER JOIN oe_hdr ON (oe_line.order_no = oe_hdr.order_no)  LEFT JOIN revision_transaction ON revision_transaction.transaction_no = cast(oe_line.order_no as int)
    AND revision_transaction.transaction_line_no = oe_line.line_no AND revision_transaction.transaction_code_no IN (1533, 1207, 1721)  LEFT JOIN p21_view_getrevisionlotquantity ON p21_view_getrevisionlotquantity.inv_mast_uid = oe_line.inv_mast_uid
    AND p21_view_getrevisionlotquantity.location_id = oe_line.source_loc_id
    AND p21_view_getrevisionlotquantity.item_revision_uid = revision_transaction.item_revision_uid  LEFT JOIN item_revision ON item_revision.item_revision_uid = revision_transaction.item_revision_uid
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT oe_line_po.order_number, oe_line_po.line_number, count(po_no) open_linked_po_count
    FROM oe_line_po
    WHERE(oe_line_po.connection_type = 'P' AND oe_line_po.delete_flag = 'N' AND oe_line_po.completed = 'N' AND oe_line_po.cancel_flag = 'N')
    GROUP BY oe_line_po.order_number, oe_line_po.line_number)
    AS drv_LinkedOpenPOs on drv_LinkedOpenPOs.order_number = oe_line.order_no AND drv_LinkedOpenPOs.line_number = oe_line.line_no  LEFT JOIN job_price_line ON (job_price_line.job_price_line_uid = oe_line.job_price_line_uid AND job_price_line.row_status_flag = 704)  LEFT JOIN oe_line_promise_date ON (oe_line.oe_line_uid = oe_line_promise_date.oe_line_uid)  LEFT JOIN oe_line oe_line_quote ON (oe_line_quote.oe_line_uid = oe_line.quote_price_oe_line_uid)  LEFT JOIN oe_line_labor ON (oe_line.oe_line_uid = oe_line_labor.oe_line_uid)  LEFT JOIN operation ON (oe_line.operation_uid = operation.operation_uid)  LEFT JOIN service_labor ON (oe_line.service_labor_uid = service_labor.service_labor_uid)  LEFT JOIN carrier_contract_line ON (carrier_contract_line.carrier_contract_line_uid = oe_line.cost_carrier_contract_line_uid)  LEFT JOIN carrier_contract_z_line ON (carrier_contract_z_line.carrier_contract_z_line_uid = oe_line.cost_carrier_contract_z_line_uid)  LEFT JOIN oe_line_room ON oe_line_room.oe_line_room_uid = ( SELECT TOP 1 oe_line_room.oe_line_room_uid
    FROM oe_line_room
    WHERE oe_line_uid = oe_line.oe_line_uid )  LEFT JOIN room ON oe_line_room.room_uid = room.room_uid  LEFT JOIN inventory_supplier_x_loc as inv_sup_x_sales_loc ON (inventory_supplier.inventory_supplier_uid = inv_sup_x_sales_loc.inventory_supplier_uid)
    AND (inv_sup_x_sales_loc.location_id = oe_hdr.location_id)
    LEFT JOIN oe_line_notepad ON oe_line_notepad.note_id = (SELECT TOP 1 oe_line_notepad.note_id
    FROM oe_line_notepad
    WHERE oe_line_notepad.order_no = oe_line.order_no
    AND oe_line_notepad.line_no = oe_line.line_no
    AND oe_line_notepad.delete_flag = 'N')  LEFT JOIN oe_line_notepad oe_line_notepad_oldest ON oe_line_notepad_oldest.note_id = oe_line_notepad.note_id
    LEFT JOIN room_area on room_area.room_area_uid = oe_line_room.room_area_uid  LEFT JOIN p21_view_oe_line_anticipated_allocation_summary ON p21_view_oe_line_anticipated_allocation_summary.order_no = oe_line.order_no
    AND p21_view_oe_line_anticipated_allocation_summary.line_no = oe_line.line_no  LEFT JOIN oe_line_lot_billing on oe_line_lot_billing.oe_line_uid = oe_line.oe_line_uid
    LEFT JOIN restricted_class ON restricted_class.restricted_class_uid = oe_line.restricted_class_uid  LEFT JOIN ( SELECT oe_line_po.order_number, oe_line_po.line_number, SUM(oe_line_po.quantity_on_po) qty_on_oe_transfer_reserve
    FROM oe_line_po
    INNER JOIN transfer_hdr ON oe_line_po.po_no = transfer_hdr.transfer_no
    AND transfer_hdr.oe_transfer_reserve_flag = 'Y'
    AND transfer_hdr.delete_flag = 'N'
    WHERE oe_line_po.connection_type = 'T'
    AND oe_line_po.delete_flag = 'N'
    GROUP BY oe_line_po.order_number, oe_line_po.line_number
    ) drv_OpenOETransferReserveQty ON drv_OpenOETransferReserveQty.order_number = oe_line.order_no
    AND drv_OpenOETransferReserveQty.line_number = oe_line.line_no  LEFT JOIN oe_line_rma ON (oe_line_rma.oe_line_uid = oe_line.oe_line_uid) and oe_line_rma.row_status_flag = 704  LEFT JOIN invoice_line ON (invoice_line.invoice_line_uid = oe_line_rma.invoice_line_uid)  LEFT JOIN price_page ON price_page.price_page_uid = oe_line.price_page_uid  LEFT JOIN price_family ON price_family.price_family_uid = oe_line.price_family_uid  LEFT JOIN shipping_route ON (shipping_route.shipping_route_uid = oe_line.shipping_route_uid)
  /*MAIN WHERE CLAUSE*/
    WHERE oe_line.delete_flag = 'N' /*MAIN GROUP BY CLAUSE*/
    /*MAIN HAVING CLAUSE*/

columns.label: Prev Unit Price

columns.label: Prev Qty Ordered

sales_cost_profit.expression: CASE oe_line.extended_price WHEN 0 THEN 0 ELSE (oe_line.extended_price - (( oe_line.sales_cost / oe_line.pricing_unit_size ) * oe_line.qty_ordered)) / oe_line.extended_price * 100 END

commission_cost_profit.expression: CASE oe_line.extended_price WHEN 0 THEN 0 ELSE (oe_line.extended_price - (( oe_line.commission_cost / oe_line.pricing_unit_size ) * oe_line.qty_ordered)) / oe_line.extended_price * 100 END

other_cost_profit.expression: CASE oe_line.extended_price WHEN 0 THEN 0 ELSE (oe_line.extended_price - (( oe_line.other_cost / oe_line.pricing_unit_size ) * oe_line.qty_ordered)) / oe_line.extended_price * 100 END

    /*MAIN FROM CLAUSE*/ FROM oe_line
    INNER JOIN inv_loc ON (inv_loc.inv_mast_uid = oe_line.inv_mast_uid)
    AND (inv_loc.location_id = oe_line.source_loc_id)  INNER JOIN inv_mast ON (inv_mast.inv_mast_uid = inv_loc.inv_mast_uid)  INNER JOIN product_group ON (product_group.product_group_id = oe_line.product_group_id)
    AND (product_group.company_id = inv_loc.company_id)  LEFT JOIN item_uom ON (item_uom.inv_mast_uid = oe_line.inv_mast_uid)
    AND (item_uom.unit_of_measure = oe_line.unit_of_measure)  LEFT JOIN inventory_supplier ON (inventory_supplier.inv_mast_uid = oe_line.inv_mast_uid)
    AND (inventory_supplier.supplier_id = oe_line.supplier_id)  LEFT JOIN inventory_supplier_x_loc ON (inventory_supplier.inventory_supplier_uid = inventory_supplier_x_loc.inventory_supplier_uid)
    AND (inventory_supplier_x_loc.location_id = oe_line.source_loc_id)  LEFT JOIN ( SELECT tpcx_dead_stock.inv_mast_uid, MAX(tpcx_dead_stock.tpcx_dead_stock_uid) tpcx_dead_stock_uid
    FROM tpcx_dead_stock
    GROUP BY tpcx_dead_stock.inv_mast_uid
    ) AS drv_TPCxDeadStock ON (drv_TPCxDeadStock.inv_mast_uid = inv_mast.inv_mast_uid)  INNER JOIN supplier ON (supplier.supplier_id = oe_line.supplier_id)  LEFT JOIN inv_loc_stock_status ON (inv_loc.inv_mast_uid = inv_loc_stock_status.inv_mast_uid)
    AND (inv_loc.location_id = inv_loc_stock_status.location_id)  LEFT JOIN inv_mast_assem_info ON (inv_mast_assem_info.inv_mast_uid = inv_mast.inv_mast_uid)  LEFT JOIN oe_line_hose_assembly ON (oe_line_hose_assembly.oe_line_uid = oe_line.oe_line_uid)  LEFT  JOIN oe_line_last_margin_price ON (oe_line_last_margin_price.oe_line_uid = oe_line.oe_line_uid)  LEFT  JOIN address ON (address.id = oe_line.item_bill_to_id)  INNER JOIN oe_hdr ON (oe_line.order_no = oe_hdr.order_no)  LEFT JOIN revision_transaction ON revision_transaction.transaction_no = cast(oe_line.order_no as int)
    AND revision_transaction.transaction_line_no = oe_line.line_no AND revision_transaction.transaction_code_no IN (1533, 1207, 1721)  LEFT JOIN p21_view_getrevisionlotquantity ON p21_view_getrevisionlotquantity.inv_mast_uid = oe_line.inv_mast_uid
    AND p21_view_getrevisionlotquantity.location_id = oe_line.source_loc_id
    AND p21_view_getrevisionlotquantity.item_revision_uid = revision_transaction.item_revision_uid  LEFT JOIN item_revision ON item_revision.item_revision_uid = revision_transaction.item_revision_uid
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT oe_line_po.order_number, oe_line_po.line_number, count(po_no) open_linked_po_count
    FROM oe_line_po
    WHERE(oe_line_po.connection_type = 'P' AND oe_line_po.delete_flag = 'N' AND oe_line_po.completed = 'N' AND oe_line_po.cancel_flag = 'N')
    GROUP BY oe_line_po.order_number, oe_line_po.line_number)
    AS drv_LinkedOpenPOs on drv_LinkedOpenPOs.order_number = oe_line.order_no AND drv_LinkedOpenPOs.line_number = oe_line.line_no  LEFT JOIN job_price_line ON (job_price_line.job_price_line_uid = oe_line.job_price_line_uid AND job_price_line.row_status_flag = 704)  LEFT JOIN oe_line_promise_date ON (oe_line.oe_line_uid = oe_line_promise_date.oe_line_uid)  LEFT JOIN oe_line oe_line_quote ON (oe_line_quote.oe_line_uid = oe_line.quote_price_oe_line_uid)  LEFT JOIN oe_line_labor ON (oe_line.oe_line_uid = oe_line_labor.oe_line_uid)  LEFT JOIN operation ON (oe_line.operation_uid = operation.operation_uid)  LEFT JOIN service_labor ON (oe_line.service_labor_uid = service_labor.service_labor_uid)  LEFT JOIN carrier_contract_line ON (carrier_contract_line.carrier_contract_line_uid = oe_line.cost_carrier_contract_line_uid)  LEFT JOIN carrier_contract_z_line ON (carrier_contract_z_line.carrier_contract_z_line_uid = oe_line.cost_carrier_contract_z_line_uid)  LEFT JOIN oe_line_room ON oe_line_room.oe_line_room_uid = ( SELECT TOP 1 oe_line_room.oe_line_room_uid
    FROM oe_line_room
    WHERE oe_line_uid = oe_line.oe_line_uid )  LEFT JOIN room ON oe_line_room.room_uid = room.room_uid  LEFT JOIN inventory_supplier_x_loc as inv_sup_x_sales_loc ON (inventory_supplier.inventory_supplier_uid = inv_sup_x_sales_loc.inventory_supplier_uid)
    AND (inv_sup_x_sales_loc.location_id = oe_hdr.location_id)
    LEFT JOIN oe_line_notepad ON oe_line_notepad.note_id = (SELECT TOP 1 oe_line_notepad.note_id
    FROM oe_line_notepad
    WHERE oe_line_notepad.order_no = oe_line.order_no
    AND oe_line_notepad.line_no = oe_line.line_no
    AND oe_line_notepad.delete_flag = 'N')  LEFT JOIN oe_line_notepad oe_line_notepad_oldest ON oe_line_notepad_oldest.note_id = oe_line_notepad.note_id
    LEFT JOIN room_area on room_area.room_area_uid = oe_line_room.room_area_uid  LEFT JOIN p21_view_oe_line_anticipated_allocation_summary ON p21_view_oe_line_anticipated_allocation_summary.order_no = oe_line.order_no
    AND p21_view_oe_line_anticipated_allocation_summary.line_no = oe_line.line_no  LEFT JOIN oe_line_lot_billing on oe_line_lot_billing.oe_line_uid = oe_line.oe_line_uid
    LEFT JOIN restricted_class ON restricted_class.restricted_class_uid = oe_line.restricted_class_uid  LEFT JOIN ( SELECT oe_line_po.order_number, oe_line_po.line_number, SUM(oe_line_po.quantity_on_po) qty_on_oe_transfer_reserve
    FROM oe_line_po
    INNER JOIN transfer_hdr ON oe_line_po.po_no = transfer_hdr.transfer_no
    AND transfer_hdr.oe_transfer_reserve_flag = 'Y'
    AND transfer_hdr.delete_flag = 'N'
    WHERE oe_line_po.connection_type = 'T'
    AND oe_line_po.delete_flag = 'N'
    GROUP BY oe_line_po.order_number, oe_line_po.line_number
    ) drv_OpenOETransferReserveQty ON drv_OpenOETransferReserveQty.order_number = oe_line.order_no
    AND drv_OpenOETransferReserveQty.line_number = oe_line.line_no  LEFT JOIN oe_line_rma ON (oe_line_rma.oe_line_uid = oe_line.oe_line_uid) and oe_line_rma.row_status_flag = 704  LEFT JOIN invoice_line ON (invoice_line.invoice_line_uid = oe_line_rma.invoice_line_uid)  LEFT JOIN price_page ON price_page.price_page_uid = oe_line.price_page_uid  LEFT JOIN price_family ON price_family.price_family_uid = oe_line.price_family_uid  LEFT JOIN shipping_route ON (shipping_route.shipping_route_uid = oe_line.shipping_route_uid)

    ,oe_line.quote_price_disposition
    ,inv_mast.default_purchase_disc_group
    ,inv_mast.default_sales_discount_group
    /*MAIN FROM CLAUSE*/ FROM oe_line
    INNER JOIN inv_loc ON (inv_loc.inv_mast_uid = oe_line.inv_mast_uid)
    AND (inv_loc.location_id = oe_line.source_loc_id)  INNER JOIN inv_mast ON (inv_mast.inv_mast_uid = inv_loc.inv_mast_uid)  INNER JOIN product_group ON (product_group.product_group_id = oe_line.product_group_id)
    AND (product_group.company_id = inv_loc.company_id)  LEFT JOIN item_uom ON (item_uom.inv_mast_uid = oe_line.inv_mast_uid)
    AND (item_uom.unit_of_measure = oe_line.unit_of_measure)  LEFT JOIN inventory_supplier ON (inventory_supplier.inv_mast_uid = oe_line.inv_mast_uid)
    AND (inventory_supplier.supplier_id = oe_line.supplier_id)  LEFT JOIN inventory_supplier_x_loc ON (inventory_supplier.inventory_supplier_uid = inventory_supplier_x_loc.inventory_supplier_uid)
    AND (inventory_supplier_x_loc.location_id = oe_line.source_loc_id)  LEFT JOIN ( SELECT tpcx_dead_stock.inv_mast_uid, MAX(tpcx_dead_stock.tpcx_dead_stock_uid) tpcx_dead_stock_uid
    FROM tpcx_dead_stock
    GROUP BY tpcx_dead_stock.inv_mast_uid
    ) AS drv_TPCxDeadStock ON (drv_TPCxDeadStock.inv_mast_uid = inv_mast.inv_mast_uid)  INNER JOIN supplier ON (supplier.supplier_id = oe_line.supplier_id)  LEFT JOIN inv_loc_stock_status ON (inv_loc.inv_mast_uid = inv_loc_stock_status.inv_mast_uid)
    AND (inv_loc.location_id = inv_loc_stock_status.location_id)  LEFT JOIN inv_mast_assem_info ON (inv_mast_assem_info.inv_mast_uid = inv_mast.inv_mast_uid)  LEFT JOIN oe_line_hose_assembly ON (oe_line_hose_assembly.oe_line_uid = oe_line.oe_line_uid)  LEFT  JOIN oe_line_last_margin_price ON (oe_line_last_margin_price.oe_line_uid = oe_line.oe_line_uid)  LEFT  JOIN address ON (address.id = oe_line.item_bill_to_id)  INNER JOIN oe_hdr ON (oe_line.order_no = oe_hdr.order_no)  LEFT JOIN revision_transaction ON revision_transaction.transaction_no = cast(oe_line.order_no as int)
    AND revision_transaction.transaction_line_no = oe_line.line_no AND revision_transaction.transaction_code_no IN (1533, 1207, 1721)  LEFT JOIN p21_view_getrevisionlotquantity ON p21_view_getrevisionlotquantity.inv_mast_uid = oe_line.inv_mast_uid
    AND p21_view_getrevisionlotquantity.location_id = oe_line.source_loc_id
    AND p21_view_getrevisionlotquantity.item_revision_uid = revision_transaction.item_revision_uid  LEFT JOIN item_revision ON item_revision.item_revision_uid = revision_transaction.item_revision_uid
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT oe_line_po.order_number, oe_line_po.line_number, count(po_no) open_linked_po_count
    FROM oe_line_po
    WHERE(oe_line_po.connection_type = 'P' AND oe_line_po.delete_flag = 'N' AND oe_line_po.completed = 'N' AND oe_line_po.cancel_flag = 'N')
    GROUP BY oe_line_po.order_number, oe_line_po.line_number)
    AS drv_LinkedOpenPOs on drv_LinkedOpenPOs.order_number = oe_line.order_no AND drv_LinkedOpenPOs.line_number = oe_line.line_no  LEFT JOIN job_price_line ON (job_price_line.job_price_line_uid = oe_line.job_price_line_uid AND job_price_line.row_status_flag = 704)  LEFT JOIN oe_line_promise_date ON (oe_line.oe_line_uid = oe_line_promise_date.oe_line_uid)  LEFT JOIN oe_line oe_line_quote ON (oe_line_quote.oe_line_uid = oe_line.quote_price_oe_line_uid)  LEFT JOIN oe_line_labor ON (oe_line.oe_line_uid = oe_line_labor.oe_line_uid)  LEFT JOIN operation ON (oe_line.operation_uid = operation.operation_uid)  LEFT JOIN service_labor ON (oe_line.service_labor_uid = service_labor.service_labor_uid)  LEFT JOIN carrier_contract_line ON (carrier_contract_line.carrier_contract_line_uid = oe_line.cost_carrier_contract_line_uid)  LEFT JOIN carrier_contract_z_line ON (carrier_contract_z_line.carrier_contract_z_line_uid = oe_line.cost_carrier_contract_z_line_uid)  LEFT JOIN oe_line_room ON oe_line_room.oe_line_room_uid = ( SELECT TOP 1 oe_line_room.oe_line_room_uid
    FROM oe_line_room
    WHERE oe_line_uid = oe_line.oe_line_uid )  LEFT JOIN room ON oe_line_room.room_uid = room.room_uid  LEFT JOIN inventory_supplier_x_loc as inv_sup_x_sales_loc ON (inventory_supplier.inventory_supplier_uid = inv_sup_x_sales_loc.inventory_supplier_uid)
    AND (inv_sup_x_sales_loc.location_id = oe_hdr.location_id)
    LEFT JOIN oe_line_notepad ON oe_line_notepad.note_id = (SELECT TOP 1 oe_line_notepad.note_id
    FROM oe_line_notepad
    WHERE oe_line_notepad.order_no = oe_line.order_no
    AND oe_line_notepad.line_no = oe_line.line_no
    AND oe_line_notepad.delete_flag = 'N')  LEFT JOIN oe_line_notepad oe_line_notepad_oldest ON oe_line_notepad_oldest.note_id = oe_line_notepad.note_id
    LEFT JOIN room_area on room_area.room_area_uid = oe_line_room.room_area_uid  LEFT JOIN p21_view_oe_line_anticipated_allocation_summary ON p21_view_oe_line_anticipated_allocation_summary.order_no = oe_line.order_no
    AND p21_view_oe_line_anticipated_allocation_summary.line_no = oe_line.line_no  LEFT JOIN oe_line_lot_billing on oe_line_lot_billing.oe_line_uid = oe_line.oe_line_uid
    LEFT JOIN restricted_class ON restricted_class.restricted_class_uid = oe_line.restricted_class_uid  LEFT JOIN ( SELECT oe_line_po.order_number, oe_line_po.line_number, SUM(oe_line_po.quantity_on_po) qty_on_oe_transfer_reserve
    FROM oe_line_po
    INNER JOIN transfer_hdr ON oe_line_po.po_no = transfer_hdr.transfer_no
    AND transfer_hdr.oe_transfer_reserve_flag = 'Y'
    AND transfer_hdr.delete_flag = 'N'
    WHERE oe_line_po.connection_type = 'T'
    AND oe_line_po.delete_flag = 'N'
    GROUP BY oe_line_po.order_number, oe_line_po.line_number
    ) drv_OpenOETransferReserveQty ON drv_OpenOETransferReserveQty.order_number = oe_line.order_no
    AND drv_OpenOETransferReserveQty.line_number = oe_line.line_no  LEFT JOIN oe_line_rma ON (oe_line_rma.oe_line_uid = oe_line.oe_line_uid) and oe_line_rma.row_status_flag = 704  LEFT JOIN invoice_line ON (invoice_line.invoice_line_uid = oe_line_rma.invoice_line_uid)  LEFT JOIN price_page ON price_page.price_page_uid = oe_line.price_page_uid  LEFT JOIN price_family ON price_family.price_family_uid = oe_line.price_family_uid  LEFT JOIN shipping_route ON (shipping_route.shipping_route_uid = oe_line.shipping_route_uid)
  /*MAIN WHERE CLAUSE*/
    WHERE oe_line.delete_flag = 'N' /*MAIN GROUP BY CLAUSE*/
    /*MAIN HAVING CLAUSE*/
    /*MAIN ORDER BY CLAUSE*/

    /*MAIN FROM CLAUSE*/ FROM oe_line
    INNER JOIN inv_loc ON (inv_loc.inv_mast_uid = oe_line.inv_mast_uid)
    AND (inv_loc.location_id = oe_line.source_loc_id)  INNER JOIN inv_mast ON (inv_mast.inv_mast_uid = inv_loc.inv_mast_uid)  INNER JOIN product_group ON (product_group.product_group_id = oe_line.product_group_id)
    AND (product_group.company_id = inv_loc.company_id)  LEFT JOIN item_uom ON (item_uom.inv_mast_uid = oe_line.inv_mast_uid)
    AND (item_uom.unit_of_measure = oe_line.unit_of_measure)  LEFT JOIN inventory_supplier ON (inventory_supplier.inv_mast_uid = oe_line.inv_mast_uid)
    AND (inventory_supplier.supplier_id = oe_line.supplier_id)  LEFT JOIN inventory_supplier_x_loc ON (inventory_supplier.inventory_supplier_uid = inventory_supplier_x_loc.inventory_supplier_uid)
    AND (inventory_supplier_x_loc.location_id = oe_line.source_loc_id)  LEFT JOIN ( SELECT tpcx_dead_stock.inv_mast_uid, MAX(tpcx_dead_stock.tpcx_dead_stock_uid) tpcx_dead_stock_uid
    FROM tpcx_dead_stock
    GROUP BY tpcx_dead_stock.inv_mast_uid
    ) AS drv_TPCxDeadStock ON (drv_TPCxDeadStock.inv_mast_uid = inv_mast.inv_mast_uid)  INNER JOIN supplier ON (supplier.supplier_id = oe_line.supplier_id)  LEFT JOIN inv_loc_stock_status ON (inv_loc.inv_mast_uid = inv_loc_stock_status.inv_mast_uid)
    AND (inv_loc.location_id = inv_loc_stock_status.location_id)  LEFT JOIN inv_mast_assem_info ON (inv_mast_assem_info.inv_mast_uid = inv_mast.inv_mast_uid)  LEFT JOIN oe_line_hose_assembly ON (oe_line_hose_assembly.oe_line_uid = oe_line.oe_line_uid)  LEFT  JOIN oe_line_last_margin_price ON (oe_line_last_margin_price.oe_line_uid = oe_line.oe_line_uid)  LEFT  JOIN address ON (address.id = oe_line.item_bill_to_id)  INNER JOIN oe_hdr ON (oe_line.order_no = oe_hdr.order_no)  LEFT JOIN revision_transaction ON revision_transaction.transaction_no = cast(oe_line.order_no as int)
    AND revision_transaction.transaction_line_no = oe_line.line_no AND revision_transaction.transaction_code_no IN (1533, 1207, 1721)  LEFT JOIN p21_view_getrevisionlotquantity ON p21_view_getrevisionlotquantity.inv_mast_uid = oe_line.inv_mast_uid
    AND p21_view_getrevisionlotquantity.location_id = oe_line.source_loc_id
    AND p21_view_getrevisionlotquantity.item_revision_uid = revision_transaction.item_revision_uid  LEFT JOIN item_revision ON item_revision.item_revision_uid = revision_transaction.item_revision_uid
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT oe_line_po.order_number, oe_line_po.line_number, count(po_no) open_linked_po_count
    FROM oe_line_po
    WHERE(oe_line_po.connection_type = 'P' AND oe_line_po.delete_flag = 'N' AND oe_line_po.completed = 'N' AND oe_line_po.cancel_flag = 'N')
    GROUP BY oe_line_po.order_number, oe_line_po.line_number)

datawindows.select_sql:
SELECT TOP 5 oe_line.order_no,
    oe_line.line_no,
    oe_hdr.po_no,
    oe_line.date_created,
    CASE :UOM
    WHEN '' THEN CASE unit_size
    WHEN 0 THEN 0
    ELSE CAST(oe_line.qty_ordered / unit_size AS Decimal(19,9))
    END
    WHEN oe_line.unit_of_measure THEN CASE unit_size
    WHEN 0 THEN 0
    ELSE CAST(oe_line.qty_ordered / unit_size AS Decimal(19,9))
    END
    ELSE CASE :UomSize
    WHEN 0 THEN 0
    ELSE CAST(oe_line.qty_ordered / :UomSize AS Decimal(19,9))
    END
    END,
    CASE :UOM
    WHEN '' THEN oe_line.unit_of_measure
    ELSE :UOM
    END AS [unit_of_measure],
    oe_hdr.projected_order,
    CASE :UOM
    WHEN '' THEN CASE pricing_unit_size
    WHEN 0 THEN 0
    ELSE CAST((oe_line.unit_price / pricing_unit_size) * unit_size AS Decimal(19,9))
    END
    WHEN oe_line.unit_of_measure THEN CASE pricing_unit_size
    WHEN 0 THEN 0
    ELSE CAST((oe_line.unit_price / pricing_unit_size) * unit_size AS Decimal(19,9))
    END
    ELSE CASE pricing_unit_size
    WHEN 0 THEN 0
    ELSE CAST((unit_price / pricing_unit_size) * :UomSize AS Decimal(19,9))
    END
    END AS [unit_price],
    oe_line.oe_line_uid,
    CASE
    WHEN unit_price  = 0
    THEN 0
    WHEN pricing_unit_size = 0 THEN 0
    ELSE CAST(((((unit_price / pricing_unit_size) - :CurrentCostInEaches) / (unit_price / pricing_unit_size) ) * 100) AS Decimal(19,9))
    END AS [c_gross_profit],
    0 c_unit_price,
    0 c_gp,
    oe_line.unit_size,
    currency_line.to_currency_id
    FROM oe_line
    INNER JOIN oe_hdr ON (oe_hdr.order_no = oe_line.order_no)  INNER JOIN inv_mast ON (inv_mast.inv_mast_uid = oe_line.inv_mast_uid)  LEFT JOIN currency_line ON (currency_line.currency_line_uid = oe_hdr.currency_line_uid)  WHERE (oe_line.delete_flag = 'N')  AND (oe_hdr.completed <> 'T')  AND (oe_hdr.delete_flag = 'N')  AND (oe_hdr.rma_flag = 'N' OR oe_hdr.rma_flag IS NULL)  AND (inv_mast.inv_mast_uid = :item_uid)  AND (oe_hdr.customer_id = :customer_id)  AND ((:include_quotes = 'Y') AND (oe_hdr.projected_order IS NULL OR oe_hdr.projected_order = 'N' OR oe_hdr.projected_order = 'Y')  OR
    (:include_quotes = 'N') AND (oe_hdr.projected_order IS NULL OR oe_hdr.projected_order = 'N'))  ORDER BY oe_line.date_created DESC, oe_line.order_no DESC

    po_hdr_rfq.po_no converted_from_rfq_no,
    vendor_rfq_line.delivery_info,
    vessel_receipts_hdr.vessel_receipt_number,
    vessel_receipts_hdr.vessel_name,
    vessel_receipts_container.container_name,
    CAST((vessel_receipts_line.container_qty_received - vessel_receipts_line.container_qty_unloaded) / vessel_receipts_line.container_unit_size AS decimal(19,9)) AS c_container_qty_received_units,
    vessel_receipts_line.container_uom,
    vessel_receipts_container.expected_arrival_date,
    vessel_receipts_container.vessel_receipts_container_uid,
    COALESCE((vessel_receipts_line.container_qty_received - vessel_receipts_line.container_qty_unloaded),0) container_qty_open
    , CASE COALESCE( (SELECT value FROM system_setting WHERE name = 'enable_gallons_display'), 'N')
    WHEN 'N' THEN 0
    ELSE
    COALESCE(item_uom_gallon.unit_size,0)
    END gallons_unit_size
    /*MAIN FROM CLAUSE*/
    FROM
    po_hdr  INNER JOIN po_line ON (po_line.po_no = po_hdr.po_no) AND
    (po_line.delete_flag = 'N') AND
    (po_line.complete = 'N') AND
    (po_line.cancel_flag = 'N')  LEFT JOIN oe_line_po ON oe_line_po.po_no = po_line.po_no
    AND oe_line_po.po_line_number = po_line.line_no
    AND po_hdr.po_type = 'Q'  INNER JOIN inv_mast ON (inv_mast.inv_mast_uid = po_line.inv_mast_uid)  INNER JOIN address ON (address.id = po_hdr.supplier_id)  LEFT  JOIN po_line_schedule ON (po_line.po_line_uid = po_line_schedule.po_line_uid) AND
    (IsNull(po_line_schedule.row_status_flag, 704) = 704)  INNER JOIN supplier ON supplier.supplier_id = po_hdr.supplier_id  LEFT JOIN inventory_supplier ON (inventory_supplier.inv_mast_uid = po_line.inv_mast_uid ) AND
    (inventory_supplier.supplier_id = po_hdr.supplier_id)  LEFT JOIN inventory_supplier_x_loc ON (po_hdr.location_id = inventory_supplier_x_loc.location_id ) and
    (inventory_supplier.inventory_supplier_uid = inventory_supplier_x_loc.inventory_supplier_uid )  LEFT JOIN vendor_rfq_hdr vendor_rfq_hdr_rfq_unconverted ON vendor_rfq_hdr_rfq_unconverted.po_hdr_uid = po_hdr.po_hdr_uid  LEFT JOIN vendor_rfq_hdr_x_po_hdr ON vendor_rfq_hdr_x_po_hdr.po_hdr_uid = po_hdr.po_hdr_uid  LEFT JOIN vendor_rfq_hdr ON vendor_rfq_hdr.vendor_rfq_hdr_uid = vendor_rfq_hdr_x_po_hdr.vendor_rfq_hdr_uid  LEFT JOIN po_hdr po_hdr_rfq ON vendor_rfq_hdr.po_hdr_uid = po_hdr_rfq.po_hdr_uid  LEFT JOIN vendor_rfq_line ON vendor_rfq_line.po_line_uid = po_line.po_line_uid  LEFT JOIN vessel_receipts_line ON vessel_receipts_line.po_line_uid = po_line.po_line_uid
    AND vessel_receipts_line.row_status_flag = 702
    AND COALESCE( po_line_schedule.po_line_schedule_uid, vessel_receipts_line.po_line_schedule_uid, 0 ) = COALESCE( vessel_receipts_line.po_line_schedule_uid, 0 )  LEFT JOIN vessel_receipts_hdr ON vessel_receipts_hdr.vessel_receipts_hdr_uid = vessel_receipts_line.vessel_receipts_hdr_uid  LEFT JOIN vessel_receipts_container ON vessel_receipts_container.vessel_receipts_container_uid = vessel_receipts_line.vessel_receipts_container_uid  LEFT Join system_setting system_setting_Gallon ON ( system_setting_Gallon.configuration_id = 0 AND system_setting_Gallon.name = 'Gallon_UOM' )  LEFT JOIN item_uom item_uom_gallon ON ((item_uom_gallon.inv_mast_uid = po_line.inv_mast_uid) AND
    (item_uom_gallon.unit_of_measure = system_setting_Gallon.value))  /*MAIN WHERE CLAUSE*/  WHERE  (inv_mast.item_id = :item_id) AND
    (po_hdr.delete_flag = 'N') AND
    (po_hdr.po_type <> 'D') AND
    ((po_hdr.po_type <> 'P') OR ((po_hdr.po_type = 'P') AND (po_line.line_type = 'B')))
    AND (po_hdr.approved = 'Y')  /*MAIN HAVING CLAUSE*/  /*MAIN ORDER BY CLAUSE*/  ORDER BY po_line.po_no ASC

datawindows.select_sql:
SELECT oe_pick_ticket_detail.pick_ticket_no
    ,oe_pick_ticket.print_date
    ,CASE
    WHEN (oe_pick_ticket_detail.ship_quantity = 0 AND oe_pick_ticket.invoice_id_when_shipped > 0) THEN
    NULL
    ELSE
    COALESCE(clippership_return_<id>.carrier_name, address.name)
    END c_carrier
    ,CASE
    WHEN (oe_pick_ticket_detail.ship_quantity = 0 AND oe_pick_ticket.invoice_id_when_shipped > 0) THEN
    '* * UNDERSHIPPED * *'
    ELSE
    COALESCE(clippership_return_<id>.tracking_no, drv_shipment.tracking_number, oe_pick_ticket.tracking_no)
    END c_tracking_no
    ,COALESCE(oe_pick_ticket_detail.print_quantity, oe_line.qty_ordered) print_quantity
    ,COALESCE(oe_pick_ticket_detail.ship_quantity, oe_line.qty_ordered) ship_quantity
    ,CASE
    WHEN(oe_pick_ticket_detail.ship_quantity = 0 AND oe_pick_ticket.invoice_id_when_shipped > 0) THEN
    NULL
    ELSE
    oe_pick_ticket.ship_date
    END ship_date
    ,CASE
    WHEN(oe_pick_ticket_detail.ship_quantity = 0 AND oe_pick_ticket.invoice_id_when_shipped > 0) THEN
    0
    ELSE
    COALESCE(oe_pick_ticket.invoice_no, oe_hdr.invoice_no)
    END invoice_no
    ,oe_pick_ticket.direct_shipment
    ,oe_pick_ticket.pick_and_hold
    ,oe_pick_ticket.auxiliary
    ,COALESCE(oe_pick_ticket_detail.unit_size, oe_line.unit_size) unit_size
    ,COALESCE(oe_pick_ticket_detail.unit_quantity, oe_line.unit_quantity) unit_quantity
    ,COALESCE(oe_pick_ticket_detail.unit_of_measure, oe_line.unit_of_measure) unit_of_measure
    ,oe_pick_ticket_detail.invoice_line_uid
    ,oe_pick_ticket.company_id
    ,CASE
    WHEN oe_pick_ticket_type_cd = 1921 THEN
    'Parts Pick Ticket'
    WHEN oe_pick_ticket_type_cd = 1922 THEN
    'Service Pick Ticket'
    WHEN oe_pick_ticket.direct_shipment = 'Y' THEN
    'Direct Shipment'
    WHEN oe_pick_ticket.auxiliary = 'Y' THEN
    'Auxiliary Pick Ticket'
    WHEN oe_pick_ticket.pick_and_hold = 'Y' THEN
    CASE
    WHEN oe_hdr.packing_basis = 'Tag and Hold' THEN
    'Tag And Hold'
    ELSE
    'Pick And Hold'
    END
    ELSE
    CASE ptshipment.transaction_type_cd
    WHEN 222 THEN
    'Shipped via Order Entry'
    ELSE
    'Regular Pick Ticket'
    END
    END
    +
    CASE
    WHEN COALESCE(clippership_return_<id>.clippership_return_uid, 0) < > 0 THEN
    ' (Clippership)'
    WHEN COALESCE(ptshipment.shipment_uid, 0) < > 0 THEN
    ' (' + carriertype.code_description + ')'
    ELSE
    ''
    END shipment_type_display
    ,CASE ptshipment.transaction_type_cd
    WHEN 222 THEN
    oe_hdr.order_no
    ELSE
    oe_pick_ticket.pick_ticket_no
    END transaction_no
    ,drv_shipment.package_x_shipment_uid package_x_shipment_uid
    ,clippership_return_<id>.clippership_return_uid clippership_return_uid
    ,address.carrier_type_cd
    ,COALESCE(ptshipment.ship_location_id, oe_pick_ticket.location_id) ship_location_id
    ,ptshipment.transaction_type_cd transaction_type_cd
    ,oe_pick_ticket_detail.rfnav_pick_status_cd  FROM oe_hdr  INNER JOIN oe_line ON (oe_line.order_no = oe_hdr.order_no)  LEFT JOIN oe_pick_ticket ON (oe_pick_ticket.order_no = oe_hdr.order_no)  LEFT JOIN oe_pick_ticket_detail ON (oe_pick_ticket_detail.pick_ticket_no = oe_pick_ticket.pick_ticket_no)
    AND (oe_pick_ticket_detail.oe_line_no = oe_line.line_no)
    AND (oe_pick_ticket_detail.print_quantity < > 0)  LEFT JOIN clippership_return_<id> ON (clippership_return_<id>.pick_ticket_no = oe_pick_ticket.pick_ticket_no)
    AND (clippership_return_<id>.delete_flag = 'N')  LEFT JOIN shipment AS ptshipment ON (ptshipment.row_status_flag = 2175)
    AND (ptshipment.transaction_type_cd = 1000)
    AND (ptshipment.transaction_no = oe_pick_ticket.pick_ticket_no)  LEFT JOIN [address] ON ([address].id = COALESCE(ptshipment.carrier_id, oe_pick_ticket.carrier_id))  LEFT JOIN code_p21 AS carriertype ON (carriertype.code_no = [address].carrier_type_cd)  LEFT JOIN product_group ON (product_group.company_id = oe_hdr.company_id)
    AND (product_group.product_group_id = oe_line.product_group_id)  LEFT JOIN customer_terms AS customer_terms_item ON (customer_terms_item.company_id = oe_hdr.company_id)
    AND (customer_terms_item.customer_id = oe_hdr.customer_id)
    AND (customer_terms_item.type_uid = oe_line.inv_mast_uid)
    AND (customer_terms_item.type_no = 212)
    AND (customer_terms_item.row_status_flag = 704)  LEFT JOIN customer_terms AS customer_terms_pg ON (customer_terms_pg.company_id = oe_hdr.company_id)
    AND (customer_terms_pg.customer_id = oe_hdr.customer_id)
    AND (customer_terms_pg.type_uid = product_group.product_group_uid)
    AND (customer_terms_pg.type_no = 218)
    AND (customer_terms_pg.row_status_flag = 704)  LEFT JOIN (SELECT pt2.pick_ticket_no
    ,ptshipmentpackages.package_x_shipment_uid
    ,ptshipmentpackages.tracking_number
    FROM shipment AS ptshipment2
    INNER JOIN oe_pick_ticket pt2 ON (pt2.pick_ticket_no = ptshipment2.transaction_no)
    LEFT JOIN oe_pick_ticket_detail ptd2 ON (ptd2.pick_ticket_no = pt2.pick_ticket_no)
    AND (ptd2.print_quantity <> 0)
    INNER JOIN p21_view_shipped_ups_package_details AS ptshipmentpackages ON (ptshipmentpackages.shipment_uid = ptshipment2.shipment_uid)
    WHERE pt2.order_no = :order_no
    AND ptd2.oe_line_no = :line_no
    AND ptshipment2.row_status_flag = 2175
    AND ptshipment2.transaction_type_cd = 1000) AS drv_shipment ON (drv_shipment.pick_ticket_no = oe_pick_ticket.pick_ticket_no)  WHERE oe_pick_ticket.order_no = :order_no
    AND oe_pick_ticket_detail.oe_line_no = :line_no
    AND oe_pick_ticket_detail.print_quantity <> 0

datawindows.select_sql:
SELECT inv_loc.location_id,
    address.name,
    inv_mast.item_id,
    inv_mast.item_desc,
    inv_loc.company_id,
    item_uom.unit_of_measure,
    item_uom.unit_size,
    CAST(((inv_loc.qty_on_hand - inv_loc.qty_allocated - COALESCE( inv_loc_stock_status.qty_non_pickable, 0) -
    COALESCE( inv_loc_stock_status.qty_quarantined, 0) -
    COALESCE( inv_loc_stock_status.qty_frozen, 0) ) / item_uom.unit_size) AS Decimal(19,9)),
    CAST(inv_loc.qty_allocated / item_uom.unit_size AS Decimal(19,9)) ,
    CAST(inv_loc.qty_backordered / item_uom.unit_size AS Decimal(19,9)) ,
    (inv_loc.order_quantity - COALESCE(vessel_receipts.sum_qty_on_vessel,0)) / item_uom.unit_size,
    CAST(inv_loc.qty_in_transit / item_uom.unit_size AS Decimal(19,9)) ,
    COALESCE(vessel_receipts.sum_qty_on_vessel,0) / item_uom.unit_size c_qty_on_vessel,
    transfer_days.days,
    dbo.p21_fn_get_next_scheduled_transfer_date(GETDATE(), inv_loc.location_id, :to_location) AS shipment_date
    /*MAIN FROM CLAUSE*/
    FROM inv_loc
    INNER JOIN address ON address.id = inv_loc.location_id
    INNER JOIN inv_mast ON inv_mast.inv_mast_uid = inv_loc.inv_mast_uid
    INNER JOIN item_uom ON item_uom.inv_mast_uid = inv_mast.inv_mast_uid
    INNER JOIN location ON inv_loc.location_id = location.location_id
    LEFT JOIN inv_loc_stock_status ON ( inv_loc.location_id = inv_loc_stock_status.location_id) AND
    ( inv_loc.inv_mast_uid = inv_loc_stock_status.inv_mast_uid)
    LEFT JOIN  (
    SELECT po_line.inv_mast_uid,
    po_hdr.location_id,
    SUM(
    CASE WHEN COALESCE(po_line.line_type, po_hdr.po_type) ='P' THEN 0
    ELSE vessel_receipts_line.container_qty_received - vessel_receipts_line.container_qty_unloaded
    END
    ) AS sum_qty_on_vessel
    FROM vessel_receipts_line
    INNER JOIN vessel_receipts_hdr ON vessel_receipts_hdr.vessel_receipts_hdr_uid = vessel_receipts_line.vessel_receipts_hdr_uid
    INNER JOIN po_line ON po_line.po_line_uid = vessel_receipts_line.po_line_uid
    INNER JOIN po_hdr ON po_line.po_no = po_hdr.po_no
    WHERE vessel_receipts_line.row_status_flag = 702
    AND vessel_receipts_hdr.row_status_flag = 972
    GROUP BY po_line.inv_mast_uid,
    po_hdr.location_id
    ) AS vessel_receipts ON vessel_receipts.inv_mast_uid = inv_loc.inv_mast_uid
    AND vessel_receipts.location_id = inv_loc.location_id
    LEFT JOIN transfer_days ON transfer_days.from_location = inv_loc.location_id AND transfer_days.to_location = :to_location
    /*MAIN WHERE CLAUSE*/
    WHERE inv_mast.item_id = :item_id
    AND item_uom.unit_of_measure = :unit_of_measure
    AND location.delete_flag = 'N'
    AND item_uom.unit_size > 0
    AND COALESCE(inv_loc.delete_flag, 'N')  = 'N'
    /*MAIN GROUP BY CLAUSE*/
    /*MAIN HAVING CLAUSE*/
    /*MAIN ORDER BY CLAUSE*/
    ORDER BY inv_loc.location_id ASC

    WHEN -1 THEN
    0
    WHEN 0 THEN
    0
    ELSE
    IsNull(drv_po_line_schedule.sum_releases, 1)
    END releases,
    oe_line_po.date_created,
    oe_line_po.date_last_modified,
    oe_line_po.last_maintained_by,
    oe_line_po.completed,
    po_hdr.currency_id,

    COALESCE(vendor_rfq_hdr.control_no, vendor_rfq_hdr_rfq_unconverted.control_no) control_no,
    CASE po_hdr.po_type
    WHEN 'Q' THEN
    'Y'
    ELSE
    'N'
    END cc_isRFQ,
    CASE supplier.lead_time_source
    WHEN 'ITEM' THEN
    inventory_supplier_x_loc.average_lead_time
    WHEN 'SUPPLIER' THEN
    supplier.average_lead_time
    END cc_lead_time,
    po_hdr_rfq.po_no converted_from_rfq_no,
    vendor_rfq_line.delivery_info,
    oe_line_po.cancel_flag,

    NULL,
    NULL,
    NULL,
    NULL,
    NULL,
    NULL,
    NULL,
    address.central_phone_number
    ,'N' oe_transfer_reserve_flag  /*MAIN FROM CLAUSE*/
    FROM
    oe_line_po
    INNER JOIN po_hdr ON (po_hdr.po_no = oe_line_po.po_no)  INNER JOIN po_line ON (oe_line_po.po_no = po_line.po_no) AND
    (oe_line_po.po_line_number = po_line.line_no)  INNER JOIN inv_mast ON (po_line.inv_mast_uid = inv_mast.inv_mast_uid)  LEFT  JOIN address ON (address.id = po_hdr.supplier_id)  INNER JOIN supplier ON (supplier.supplier_id = po_hdr.supplier_id)  LEFT  JOIN inventory_supplier ON (inventory_supplier.inv_mast_uid = po_line.inv_mast_uid) AND
    (inventory_supplier.supplier_id = po_hdr.supplier_id)  LEFT  JOIN inventory_supplier_x_loc ON (po_hdr.location_id = inventory_supplier_x_loc.location_id) AND
    (inventory_supplier.inventory_supplier_uid = inventory_supplier_x_loc.inventory_supplier_uid)  LEFT  JOIN vendor_rfq_hdr vendor_rfq_hdr_rfq_unconverted ON (vendor_rfq_hdr_rfq_unconverted.po_hdr_uid = po_hdr.po_hdr_uid)  LEFT  JOIN vendor_rfq_hdr_x_po_hdr ON (vendor_rfq_hdr_x_po_hdr.po_hdr_uid = po_hdr.po_hdr_uid)  LEFT  JOIN vendor_rfq_hdr ON (vendor_rfq_hdr.vendor_rfq_hdr_uid = vendor_rfq_hdr_x_po_hdr.vendor_rfq_hdr_uid)  LEFT  JOIN po_hdr po_hdr_rfq ON (vendor_rfq_hdr.po_hdr_uid = po_hdr_rfq.po_Hdr_uid)  LEFT  JOIN vendor_rfq_line ON (vendor_rfq_line.po_line_uid = po_line.po_line_uid)  LEFT  JOIN (SELECT COUNT(1) sum_releases,

    NULL,
    NULL,
    NULL,
    NULL,
    NULL,
    NULL
    ,COALESCE(transfer_hdr.oe_transfer_reserve_flag, 'N')  /*MAIN FROM CLAUSE*/  FROM

    INNER JOIN transfer_hdr ON (transfer_hdr.transfer_no = oe_line_po.po_no)

    oe_line_po.last_maintained_by,
    oe_line_po.completed,
    vessel_receipts_hdr.currency_id,

    WHEN 'SUPPLIER' THEN

    po_hdr_rfq.po_no converted_from_rfq_no,
    ' ',
    oe_line_po.cancel_flag,
    oe_line_po.delete_flag,
    oe_line_po.quantity_on_po,

    ,vessel_receipts_container.vessel_receipts_container_uid,
    NULL

    INNER JOIN vessel_receipts_hdr ON vessel_receipts_hdr.vessel_receipt_number = oe_line_po.po_no  INNER JOIN vessel_receipts_line ON
    vessel_receipts_line.vessel_receipts_hdr_uid = vessel_receipts_hdr.vessel_receipts_hdr_uid
    AND oe_line_po.po_line_number = vessel_receipts_line.line_no  INNER JOIN vessel_receipts_container ON
    vessel_receipts_container.vessel_receipts_container_uid = vessel_receipts_line.vessel_receipts_container_uid  INNER JOIN po_line ON vessel_receipts_line.po_line_uid = po_line.po_line_uid  INNER JOIN po_hdr ON po_line.po_no = po_hdr.po_no  INNER JOIN inv_mast ON po_line.inv_mast_uid = inv_mast.inv_mast_uid  LEFT JOIN address ON (address.id = po_hdr.supplier_id)  INNER JOIN supplier ON (supplier.supplier_id = po_hdr.supplier_id)  LEFT  JOIN inventory_supplier ON (inventory_supplier.inv_mast_uid = po_line.inv_mast_uid) AND

    FROM

    WHERE  (po_line_schedule.row_status_flag = 704)
    GROUP BY po_line_schedule.po_line_uid)
    AS drv_po_line_schedule ON (drv_po_line_schedule.po_line_uid = po_line.po_line_uid)  LEFT JOIN po_line_schedule ON (po_line_schedule.po_line_schedule_uid = vessel_receipts_line.po_line_schedule_uid)
    AND po_line_schedule.row_status_flag = 704  LEFT  JOIN vendor_rfq_hdr_x_po_hdr ON (vendor_rfq_hdr_x_po_hdr.po_hdr_uid = po_hdr.po_hdr_uid)  LEFT  JOIN vendor_rfq_hdr ON (vendor_rfq_hdr.vendor_rfq_hdr_uid = vendor_rfq_hdr_x_po_hdr.vendor_rfq_hdr_uid)  LEFT  JOIN po_hdr po_hdr_rfq ON (vendor_rfq_hdr.po_hdr_uid = po_hdr_rfq.po_Hdr_uid)  /*MAIN WHERE CLAUSE*/  WHERE  (oe_line_po.order_number = :as_OrderNo) AND
    ((:as_DeleteFlag = 'Y') OR (oe_line_po.delete_flag = 'N')) AND
    ((:as_CancelFlag = 'Y') OR (oe_line_po.cancel_flag = 'N')) AND
    (oe_line_po.connection_type = 'V')  /*MAIN GROUP BY CLAUSE*/  /*MAIN HAVING CLAUSE*/  /*MAIN ORDER BY CLAUSE*/

datawindows.select_sql:
SELECT oe_hdr.order_no,
    address.name,
    oe_line.unit_quantity,
    oe_line.unit_of_measure,
    oe_line.disposition,
    oe_line.unit_size,
    oe_line.qty_allocated,
    oe_line.qty_invoiced,
    inv_mast.item_id,
    inv_mast.item_desc,
    oe_hdr.customer_id,
    oe_hdr.projected_order,
    oe_line.qty_canceled,
    oe_hdr.location_id,
    oe_hdr.company_id,
    oe_line.qty_on_pick_tickets,
    oe_line.qty_staged,
    oe_hdr.order_type
    ,CASE COALESCE( (SELECT value FROM system_setting WHERE name = 'enable_gallons_display'), 'N')
    WHEN 'N' THEN 0
    ELSE
    COALESCE(item_uom_gallon.unit_size,0)
    END gallons_unit_size  /*MAIN FROM CLAUSE*/
    FROM oe_line
    INNER JOIN oe_hdr ON oe_hdr.order_no = oe_line.order_no
    INNER JOIN inv_mast ON inv_mast.inv_mast_uid = oe_line.inv_mast_uid
    INNER JOIN address ON oe_hdr.customer_id = address.id
    LEFT Join system_setting system_setting_Gallon ON ( system_setting_Gallon.configuration_id = 0 AND system_setting_Gallon.name = 'Gallon_UOM' )
    LEFT JOIN item_uom item_uom_gallon ON ((item_uom_gallon.inv_mast_uid = oe_line.inv_mast_uid) AND
    (item_uom_gallon.unit_of_measure = system_setting_Gallon.value))
    /*MAIN WHERE CLAUSE*/
    WHERE inv_mast.item_id = :item_id
    AND
    oe_line.complete = 'N'
    AND oe_hdr.delete_flag = 'N'
    AND oe_hdr.cancel_flag = 'N'
    AND oe_line.delete_flag = 'N'
    AND oe_hdr.completed = 'N'  /*MAIN HAVING CLAUSE*/  /*MAIN ORDER BY CLAUSE*/
    ORDER BY oe_hdr.order_no DESC

datawindows.select_sql:
SELECT invoice_hdr.invoice_date,
    invoice_hdr.invoice_no,
    invoice_line.qty_shipped,
    invoice_line.qty_requested,
    invoice_line.unit_price,
    invoice_line.unit_of_measure,
    invoice_line.extended_price,
    invoice_hdr.order_no,
    job_price_line.line_no,
    job_price_hdr.contract_no,
    job_price_hdr.job_description,
    CASE :cost_type
    WHEN 2 THEN
    invoice_line.commission_cost * invoice_line.qty_shipped
    WHEN 3 THEN
    invoice_line.other_cost * invoice_line.qty_shipped
    ELSE
    invoice_line.cogs_amount
    END cogs_amount,
    invoice_hdr.ship2_name,
    inv_mast.item_id,
    inv_mast.item_desc,
    COALESCE(invoice_line.pricing_unit_size, 1) pricing_unit_size,
    invoice_line.pricing_unit,
    COALESCE(invoice_line.sales_unit_size, 1) order_unit_size,
    invoice_hdr.sales_location_id,
    invoice_hdr.order_date,
    currency_line.to_currency_id,
    CASE qty_shipped
    WHEN 0 THEN 0
    ELSE
    (CASE :cost_type
    WHEN 2 THEN
    invoice_line.commission_cost * invoice_line.qty_shipped
    WHEN 3 THEN
    invoice_line.other_cost * invoice_line.qty_shipped
    ELSE
    invoice_line.cogs_amount
    END) / (invoice_line.qty_shipped / invoice_line.pricing_unit_size)
    END c_unitcost,
    CASE customer.invoice_comp_cost_cd_tier1
    WHEN 2110 THEN /* Commission Cost */
    CASE WHEN (invoice_line.commission_cost * invoice_line.pricing_unit_size <> 0) THEN
    invoice_line.commission_cost * invoice_line.pricing_unit_size
    ELSE
    CASE customer.invoice_comp_cost_cd_tier2
    WHEN 2111 THEN
    CASE WHEN (CASE invoice_line.qty_shipped WHEN 0 THEN 0 ELSE CAST(invoice_line.cogs_amount / (invoice_line.qty_shipped / invoice_line.pricing_unit_size)  AS Decimal(19,9)) END) <> 0 THEN
    invoice_line.cogs_amount / (invoice_line.qty_shipped / invoice_line.pricing_unit_size)
    ELSE
    invoice_line.other_cost * invoice_line.pricing_unit_size
    END
    WHEN 1195 THEN
    CASE WHEN (invoice_line.other_cost * invoice_line.pricing_unit_size <> 0) THEN
    invoice_line.other_cost * invoice_line.pricing_unit_size
    ELSE
    (CASE invoice_line.qty_shipped WHEN 0 THEN 0 ELSE CAST(invoice_line.cogs_amount / (invoice_line.qty_shipped / invoice_line.pricing_unit_size)  AS Decimal(19,9)) END)
    END
    END
    END
    WHEN 2111 THEN  /* Order Cost */
    CASE WHEN (CASE invoice_line.qty_shipped WHEN 0 THEN 0 ELSE CAST(invoice_line.cogs_amount / (invoice_line.qty_shipped / invoice_line.pricing_unit_size)  AS Decimal(19,9)) END) <> 0 THEN
    invoice_line.cogs_amount / (invoice_line.qty_shipped / invoice_line.pricing_unit_size)
    ELSE
    CASE customer.invoice_comp_cost_cd_tier2
    WHEN 2110 THEN
    CASE WHEN (invoice_line.commission_cost * invoice_line.pricing_unit_size <> 0) THEN
    invoice_line.commission_cost * invoice_line.pricing_unit_size
    ELSE
    invoice_line.other_cost * invoice_line.pricing_unit_size
    END
    WHEN 1195 THEN
    CASE WHEN (invoice_line.other_cost * invoice_line.pricing_unit_size <> 0) THEN
    invoice_line.other_cost * invoice_line.pricing_unit_size
    ELSE
    invoice_line.commission_cost * invoice_line.pricing_unit_size
    END
    END
    END
    WHEN 1195 THEN  /* Other Cost */
    CASE WHEN (invoice_line.other_cost * invoice_line.pricing_unit_size <> 0) THEN
    invoice_line.other_cost * invoice_line.pricing_unit_size
    ELSE
    CASE customer.invoice_comp_cost_cd_tier2
    WHEN 2110 THEN
    CASE WHEN (invoice_line.commission_cost * invoice_line.pricing_unit_size <> 0) THEN
    invoice_line.commission_cost * invoice_line.pricing_unit_size
    ELSE
    (CASE invoice_line.qty_shipped WHEN 0 THEN 0 ELSE CAST(invoice_line.cogs_amount / (invoice_line.qty_shipped / invoice_line.pricing_unit_size)  AS Decimal(19,9)) END)
    END
    WHEN 2111 THEN
    CASE WHEN (CASE invoice_line.qty_shipped WHEN 0 THEN 0 ELSE CAST(invoice_line.cogs_amount / (invoice_line.qty_shipped / invoice_line.pricing_unit_size)  AS Decimal(19,9)) END) <> 0 THEN
    invoice_line.cogs_amount / (invoice_line.qty_shipped / invoice_line.pricing_unit_size)
    ELSE
    invoice_line.commission_cost * invoice_line.pricing_unit_size
    END
    END
    END
    END c_comparison_cost,
    CASE customer.invoice_comp_cost_cd_tier1
    WHEN 2110 THEN /* Commission Cost */
    CASE WHEN (invoice_line.commission_cost * invoice_line.qty_shipped <> 0) THEN
    invoice_line.commission_cost * invoice_line.qty_shipped
    ELSE
    CASE customer.invoice_comp_cost_cd_tier2
    WHEN 2111 THEN
    CASE WHEN (invoice_line.cogs_amount <> 0) THEN
    invoice_line.cogs_amount
    ELSE
    invoice_line.other_cost * invoice_line.qty_shipped
    END
    WHEN 1195 THEN
    CASE WHEN (invoice_line.other_cost * invoice_line.qty_shipped <> 0) THEN
    invoice_line.other_cost * invoice_line.qty_shipped
    ELSE
    invoice_line.cogs_amount
    END
    END
    END
    WHEN 2111 THEN  /* Order Cost */
    CASE WHEN (invoice_line.cogs_amount <> 0) THEN
    invoice_line.cogs_amount
    ELSE
    CASE customer.invoice_comp_cost_cd_tier2
    WHEN 2110 THEN
    CASE WHEN (invoice_line.commission_cost * invoice_line.qty_shipped <> 0) THEN
    invoice_line.commission_cost * invoice_line.qty_shipped
    ELSE
    invoice_line.other_cost * invoice_line.qty_shipped
    END
    WHEN 1195 THEN
    CASE WHEN (invoice_line.other_cost * invoice_line.qty_shipped <> 0) THEN
    invoice_line.other_cost * invoice_line.qty_shipped
    ELSE
    invoice_line.commission_cost * invoice_line.qty_shipped
    END
    END
    END
    WHEN 1195 THEN  /* Other Cost */
    CASE WHEN (invoice_line.other_cost * invoice_line.qty_shipped <> 0) THEN
    invoice_line.other_cost * invoice_line.qty_shipped
    ELSE
    CASE customer.invoice_comp_cost_cd_tier2
    WHEN 2110 THEN
    CASE WHEN (invoice_line.commission_cost * invoice_line.qty_shipped <> 0) THEN
    invoice_line.commission_cost * invoice_line.qty_shipped
    ELSE
    invoice_line.cogs_amount
    END
    WHEN 2111 THEN
    CASE WHEN (invoice_line.cogs_amount <> 0) THEN
    invoice_line.cogs_amount
    ELSE
    invoice_line.commission_cost * invoice_line.qty_shipped
    END
    END
    END
    END c_extended_comparison_cost,
    COALESCE(derv_Taxable.taxable, 'N') c_taxable,
    CASE WHEN invoice_hdr.source_type_cd IN (1129,1924) THEN 'Y'
    ELSE 'N'
    END c_direct_ship,
    invoice_line.line_no invoice_line_line_no
    ,CASE invoice_hdr.record_type_cd
    WHEN 2594 THEN invoice_hdr.record_type_reference_no
    ELSE ''
    END
    ,oe_hdr.po_no
    ,COALESCE(rebill_invoice_reason.reason_code, '') rebill_reason_code
    ,CASE COALESCE( (SELECT value FROM system_setting WHERE name = 'enable_gallons_display'), 'N')
    WHEN 'N' THEN 0
    ELSE
    CASE COALESCE(item_uom_gallon.unit_size,0)
    WHEN 0 THEN
    0
    ELSE
    (invoice_line.qty_shipped  / item_uom_gallon.unit_size)
    END
    END gallons_shipped
    ,CASE COALESCE( (SELECT value FROM system_setting WHERE name = 'enable_gallons_display'), 'N')
    WHEN 'N' THEN 0
    ELSE
    CASE COALESCE(item_uom_gallon.unit_size,0)
    WHEN 0 THEN
    0
    ELSE
    (invoice_line.qty_requested
    / item_uom_gallon.unit_size)
    END
    END gallons_ordered
    ,CASE invoice_hdr.source_type_cd
    WHEN 2871 THEN 'Y'
    ELSE 'N'
    END prod_order_adjustment_invoice
    ,invoice_line.tariff_detail_uid
    ,invoice_line.tariff_percent
    /*MAIN FROM CLAUSE*/  FROM invoice_line  INNER JOIN invoice_hdr ON invoice_hdr.invoice_no = invoice_line.invoice_no  INNER JOIN inv_mast ON inv_mast.inv_mast_uid = invoice_line.inv_mast_uid  LEFT JOIN job_price_line ON job_price_line.job_price_line_uid = invoice_line.job_price_line_uid  LEFT JOIN job_price_hdr ON job_price_hdr.job_price_hdr_uid = job_price_line.job_price_hdr_uid  LEFT JOIN oe_hdr ON oe_hdr.order_no = invoice_hdr.order_no  LEFT JOIN currency_line ON currency_line.currency_line_uid = oe_hdr.currency_line_uid  LEFT JOIN ( SELECT invoice_no, line_no, taxable
    FROM invoice_line_taxes
    WHERE taxable = 'Y'
    GROUP BY invoice_no, line_no, taxable
    ) AS derv_Taxable ON derv_Taxable.invoice_no = invoice_line.invoice_no
    AND derv_Taxable.line_no = invoice_line.line_no  INNER JOIN customer ON customer.company_id = invoice_hdr.company_no
    AND customer.customer_id = invoice_hdr.sold_to_customer_id  LEFT JOIN rebill_invoice_reason ON rebill_invoice_reason.rebill_invoice_reason_uid = invoice_hdr.rebill_invoice_reason_uid  LEFT Join system_setting system_setting_Gallon ON system_setting_Gallon.configuration_id = 0
    AND system_setting_Gallon.name = 'Gallon_UOM'  LEFT JOIN item_uom item_uom_gallon ON item_uom_gallon.inv_mast_uid = invoice_line.inv_mast_uid
    AND item_uom_gallon.unit_of_measure = system_setting_Gallon.value  /*MAIN WHERE CLAUSE*/  WHERE invoice_hdr.company_no = :company_id
    AND invoice_hdr.sold_to_customer_id = :customer_id
    AND inv_mast.item_id = :item_id
    AND COALESCE(invoice_hdr.record_type_cd, 0) <> 4015  /*MAIN GROUP BY CLAUSE*/  /*MAIN HAVING CLAUSE*/  /*MAIN ORDER BY CLAUSE*/
