(invoice_line.commission_cost * invoice_line.pricing_unit_size <> 0) THEN invoice_line.commission_cost * invoice_line.pricing_unit_size ELSE invoice_line.other_cost * invoice_line.pricing_unit_size END WHEN 1195 THEN CASE WHEN (invoice_line.other_cost * invoice_line.pricing_unit_size <> 0) THEN invoice_line.other_cost * invoice_line.pricing_unit_size ELSE invoice_line.commission_cost * invoice_line.pricing_unit_size END END END WHEN 1195 THEN CASE WHEN (invoice_line.other_cost * invoice_line.pricing_unit_size <> 0) THEN invoice_line.other_cost * invoice_line.pricing_unit_size ELSE CASE customer.invoice_comp_cost_cd_tier2 WHEN 2110 THEN CASE WHEN (invoice_line.commission_cost * invoice_line.pricing_unit_size <> 0) THEN invoice_line.commission_cost * invoice_line.pricing_unit_size ELSE (CASE invoice_line.qty_shipped WHEN 0 THEN 0 ELSE CAST(invoice_line.cogs_amount / (invoice_line.qty_shipped / invoice_line.pricing_unit_size) AS Decimal(19,9)) END) END WHEN 2111 THEN CASE WHEN (CASE invoice_line.qty_shipped WHEN 0 THEN 0 ELSE CAST(invoice_line.cogs_amount / (invoice_line.qty_shipped / invoice_line.pricing_unit_size) AS Decimal(19,9)) END) <> 0 THEN invoice_line.cogs_amount / (invoice_line.qty_shipped / invoice_line.pricing_unit_size) ELSE invoice_line.commission_cost * invoice_line.pricing_unit_size END END END END

c_extended_comparison_cost.expression: CASE customer.invoice_comp_cost_cd_tier1 WHEN 2110 THEN CASE WHEN (invoice_line.commission_cost * invoice_line.qty_shipped <> 0) THEN invoice_line.commission_cost * invoice_line.qty_shipped ELSE CASE customer.invoice_comp_cost_cd_tier2 WHEN 2111 THEN CASE WHEN (invoice_line.cogs_amount <> 0) THEN invoice_line.cogs_amount ELSE invoice_line.other_cost * invoice_line.qty_shipped END WHEN 1195 THEN CASE WHEN (invoice_line.other_cost * invoice_line.qty_shipped <> 0) THEN invoice_line.other_cost * invoice_line.qty_shipped ELSE invoice_line.cogs_amount END END END WHEN 2111 THEN CASE WHEN (invoice_line.cogs_amount <> 0) THEN invoice_line.cogs_amount ELSE CASE customer.invoice_comp_cost_cd_tier2 WHEN 2110 THEN CASE WHEN (invoice_line.commission_cost * invoice_line.qty_shipped <> 0) THEN invoice_line.commission_cost * invoice_line.qty_shipped ELSE invoice_line.other_cost * invoice_line.qty_shipped END WHEN 1195 THEN CASE WHEN (invoice_line.other_cost * invoice_line.qty_shipped <> 0) THEN invoice_line.other_cost * invoice_line.qty_shipped ELSE invoice_line.commission_cost * invoice_line.qty_shipped END END END WHEN 1195 THEN CASE WHEN (invoice_line.other_cost * invoice_line.qty_shipped <> 0) THEN invoice_line.other_cost * invoice_line.qty_shipped ELSE CASE customer.invoice_comp_cost_cd_tier2 WHEN 2110 THEN CASE WHEN (invoice_line.commission_cost * invoice_line.qty_shipped <> 0) THEN invoice_line.commission_cost * invoice_line.qty_shipped ELSE invoice_line.cogs_amount END WHEN 2111 THEN CASE WHEN (invoice_line.cogs_amount <> 0) THEN invoice_line.cogs_amount ELSE invoice_line.commission_cost * invoice_line.qty_shipped END END END END

c_direct_ship.expression: CASE WHEN invoice_hdr.source_type_cd IN (1129,1924) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END

c_unitcost.expression: CASE qty_shipped WHEN 0 THEN 0 ELSE (CASE :cost_type WHEN 2 THEN invoice_line.commission_cost * invoice_line.qty_shipped WHEN 3 THEN invoice_line.other_cost * invoice_line.qty_shipped ELSE invoice_line.cogs_amount END) / (invoice_line.qty_shipped / invoice_line.pricing_unit_size) END

cogs_amount.expression: CASE :cost_type WHEN 2 THEN invoice_line.commission_cost * invoice_line.qty_shipped WHEN 3 THEN invoice_line.other_cost * invoice_line.qty_shipped ELSE invoice_line.cogs_amount END

datawindows.name: tabpage_productionorder
datawindows.select_sql:
SELECT prod_order_line_link.prod_order_number,
    prod_order_line_link.prod_order_line_number,
    prod_order_line.qty_to_make,
    prod_order_line.qty_completed,
    prod_order_line.unit_of_measure,
    prod_order_hdr.expected_completion_date,
    oe_line_schedule.release_date,
    CASE prod_order_line_link.trans_type
    WHEN 'S' THEN 'Y'
    ELSE 'N'
    END  release,
    prod_order_line.committed_start_date,
    prod_order_line.start_date,
    prod_order_line.end_date,
    prod_order_line.comment_date
    FROM prod_order_hdr
    INNER JOIN prod_order_line ON ( prod_order_line.prod_order_number = prod_order_hdr.prod_order_number )
    INNER JOIN prod_order_line_link ON
    ( prod_order_line_link.prod_order_number = prod_order_line.prod_order_number ) and
    ( prod_order_line_link.prod_order_line_number = prod_order_line.line_number ) and
    ( prod_order_line_link.prod_order_number = prod_order_hdr.prod_order_number )
    LEFT JOIN oe_line_schedule ON (oe_line_schedule.oe_line_schedule_uid =prod_order_line_link.transaction_uid)
    AND (prod_order_line_link.trans_type = 'S')
    LEFT JOIN oe_line ON (oe_line.order_no = oe_line_schedule.order_no) AND (oe_line.line_no = oe_line_schedule.line_no)
    WHERE
    ( prod_order_line_link.transaction_uid = :al_TransAactionUid OR oe_line.oe_line_uid = :al_OeLineUidForSchedules) and
    ( prod_order_line_link.trans_type = :as_TransType) and
    ( Prod_order_line_link.row_status_flag not in( 'C', 'D'))
    ORDER BY prod_order_line_link.prod_order_number

release.expression: CASE prod_order_line_link.trans_type WHEN 'S' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END

datawindows.name: document_link_detail_detail
datawindows.select_sql:
SELECT document_link.document_link_uid
    ,document_link.source_area_cd
    ,document_link.key1_cd
    ,document_link.key1_value
    ,document_link.key2_cd
    ,document_link.key2_value
    ,document_link.key3_cd
    ,document_link.key3_value
    ,document_link.link_name
    ,document_link.link_path
    ,document_link.row_status_flag
    ,document_link.date_created
    ,document_link.created_by
    ,document_link.date_last_modified
    ,document_link.last_maintained_by
    ,0 add_source_row_id
    ,0 row_edited
    ,0 C_SupplierID
    ,Cast ('' AS VARCHAR(40)) C_ItemID
    ,Cast ('' AS VARCHAR(8)) C_OrderNumber
    ,0 C_OrderLineNumber
    ,inv_mast.item_id
    ,inv_mast.item_desc
    ,document_link.outside_use_flag
    ,document_link.mandatory_flag
    ,COALESCE (dler_ship_to.print_flag, dler_customer.print_flag, 'N') user_print_flag
    ,COALESCE (dler_ship_to.fax_flag, dler_customer.fax_flag, 'N') user_fax_flag
    ,COALESCE (dler_ship_to.email_flag, dler_customer.email_flag, 'N') user_email_flag
    ,COALESCE (dler_ship_to.print_flag, dler_customer.print_flag, 'N') ship_to_print_flag
    ,COALESCE (dler_ship_to.fax_flag, dler_customer.fax_flag, 'N') ship_to_fax_flag
    ,COALESCE (dler_ship_to.email_flag, dler_customer.email_flag, 'N') ship_to_email_flag
    ,COALESCE (dler_ship_to.number_of_copies, dler_customer.number_of_copies, 0) number_of_copies
    ,COALESCE (dler_ship_to.require_lot_documentation_flag, dler_customer.require_lot_documentation_flag, 'N') require_lot_documentation_flag
    ,document_link_area.display_area_cd
    ,COALESCE (dler_ship_to.send_outside_use_docs_flag, dler_customer.send_outside_use_docs_flag, 'N')
    ,COALESCE (dler_ship_to.send_outside_use_print_flag, dler_customer.send_outside_use_print_flag, 'N')
    ,COALESCE (dler_ship_to.send_outside_use_fax_flag, dler_customer.send_outside_use_fax_flag, 'N')
    ,COALESCE (dler_ship_to.send_outside_use_email_flag, dler_customer.send_outside_use_email_flag, 'N')
    ,COALESCE (dler_ship_to.outside_use_number_of_copies, dler_customer.outside_use_number_of_copies, 0)
    ,0 AS doc_link_file_handler_defaults_uid
    ,NULL AS c_file_name
    ,NULL AS c_file_path
    ,'N' AS append_datetime_flag
    ,'N' AS prompt_to_overwrite_flag  /*MAIN FROM CLAUSE*/  FROM
    document_link
    INNER JOIN document_link_area ON (document_link_area.document_link_uid = document_link.document_link_uid)
    LEFT OUTER JOIN inv_mast ON (Cast (inv_mast.inv_mast_uid AS VARCHAR(50)) = document_link.key1_value)
    AND (document_link.key1_cd = 'inv_mast_uid')
    LEFT OUTER JOIN ship_to ON (ship_to.company_id = :as_companyid)
    AND (ship_to.ship_to_id = :al_shiptoid)
    LEFT JOIN document_link_entity_req dler_customer ON (dler_customer.entity_type = 1307)
    AND (dler_customer.entity_id = ship_to.customer_id)
    AND (dler_customer.company_id = ship_to.company_id)
    LEFT OUTER JOIN document_link_entity_req dler_ship_to ON (dler_ship_to.entity_type = 1328)
    AND (dler_ship_to.entity_id = ship_to.ship_to_id)
    AND (dler_ship_to.company_id = ship_to.company_id)  /*MAIN WHERE CLAUSE*/  /*MAIN GROUP BY CLAUSE*/  GROUP  BY document_link.document_link_uid
    ,document_link.source_area_cd
    ,document_link.key1_cd
    ,document_link.key1_value
    ,document_link.key2_cd
    ,document_link.key2_value
    ,document_link.key3_cd
    ,document_link.key3_value
    ,document_link.link_name
    ,document_link.link_path
    ,document_link.row_status_flag
    ,document_link.date_created
    ,document_link.created_by
    ,document_link.date_last_modified
    ,document_link.last_maintained_by
    ,inv_mast.item_id
    ,inv_mast.item_desc
    ,document_link.outside_use_flag
    ,document_link.mandatory_flag
    ,COALESCE (dler_ship_to.print_flag, dler_customer.print_flag, 'N')
    ,COALESCE (dler_ship_to.fax_flag, dler_customer.fax_flag, 'N')
    ,COALESCE (dler_ship_to.email_flag, dler_customer.email_flag, 'N')
    ,COALESCE (dler_ship_to.number_of_copies, dler_customer.number_of_copies, 0)
    ,COALESCE (dler_ship_to.require_lot_documentation_flag, dler_customer.require_lot_documentation_flag, 'N')
    ,document_link_area.display_area_cd
    ,COALESCE (dler_ship_to.send_outside_use_docs_flag, dler_customer.send_outside_use_docs_flag, 'N')
    ,COALESCE (dler_ship_to.send_outside_use_print_flag, dler_customer.send_outside_use_print_flag, 'N')
    ,COALESCE (dler_ship_to.send_outside_use_fax_flag, dler_customer.send_outside_use_fax_flag, 'N')
    ,COALESCE (dler_ship_to.send_outside_use_email_flag, dler_customer.send_outside_use_email_flag, 'N')
    ,COALESCE (dler_ship_to.outside_use_number_of_copies, dler_customer.outside_use_number_of_copies, 0)
    ,doc_link_file_handler_defaults_uid
    ,c_file_name
    ,c_file_path
    ,append_datetime_flag
    ,prompt_to_overwrite_flag
